BR-100-1.statement: If Partial Approvals are not supported, transaction request is either approved in full or declined.
BR-100-1.constraint: Transaction is approved for full amount or declined

BR-100-2.statement: Split Tender occurs when a Partial Approval is returned; POS must prompt for remaining balance payment.
BR-100-2.condition: Partial Approval returned in transaction response
BR-100-2.constraint: POS must prompt for payment of remaining balance using another tender type

BR-101-1.statement: Clinical Services product code 890 is optional, included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-101-1.constraint: Optional; amount included in Total QHP Amount (894)

BR-101-2.statement: Dental Services product code 891 is optional, included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-101-2.constraint: Optional; amount included in Total QHP Amount (894)

BR-101-3.statement: Prescription/Rx Only product code 892 is optional, included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-101-3.constraint: Optional; amount included in Total QHP Amount (894)

BR-101-4.statement: Vision/Optical product code 893 is optional, included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-101-4.constraint: Optional; amount included in Total QHP Amount (894)

BR-101-5.statement: Total QHP Amount (code 894) is required and must sum Clinical, Dental, Prescription/Rx, and Vision/Optical amounts.

BR-101-6.statement: Co-Payment product code 895 is optional, identifies total co-payment amount.

BR-101-7.statement: Transit product code 896 is optional, identifies total transit purchase amount.

BR-102-1.statement: Market-Specific Data Indicator (MSDI) is included in FSA/HRA transaction requests.
BR-102-1.constraint: MSDI must be present in Variable Information Data Segment

BR-102-2.statement: Partial Approval Indicator is included in FSA/HRA transaction requests.
BR-102-2.constraint: Partial Approval Indicator must be present in Standard Message Data Segment

BR-102-3.statement: Product Code is included in FSA/HRA transaction requests.
BR-102-3.constraint: Product Code must be present in Product Code Data Segment

BR-102-4.statement: FSA/HRA transaction responses contain only standard response data with no FSA/HRA-specific elements.

BR-102-5.statement: Partial Approval Indicator and Product Code Data Segment fields are required in a Purchase/Capture transaction.
BR-102-5.constraint: Partial Approval Indicator and Product Code Data Segment required

BR-103-1.statement: Debit card receipt requirements apply to FSA/HRA card transactions.

BR-103-2.statement: Approved FSA/HRA receipts must print indicator identifying QHP items.

BR-103-3.statement: Approved FSA/HRA receipts must print subtotal of QHP amount including taxes and discounts.
BR-103-3.constraint: Print QHP subtotal including taxes and discounts

BR-104-1.statement: No signature line — printing a debit receipt.

BR-104-2.statement: Credit card receipt requirements from section 10.1.7 also apply to debit card receipts.
BR-104-2.constraint: Debit receipts must meet credit receipt requirements.

BR-104-3.statement: Optionally, a PIN USED message can be printed on transaction receipts when a PIN is entered.
BR-104-3.constraint: PIN USED message may be printed

BR-104-4.statement: No signature line is required when printing a debit receipt.

BR-104-5.statement: Optionally, a SIGNATURE NOT REQUIRED message can be printed on debit receipts.
BR-104-5.constraint: SIGNATURE NOT REQUIRED message may be printed

BR-105-1.statement: These two items must be separated by an "=" sign, rather than a Field Separator.
BR-105-1.constraint: separated by an "=" sign, rather than a Field Separator

BR-105-10.statement: Note: Track support requirement does not apply to TransArmor-Verifone Edition processing.

BR-105-11.statement: Track 2 data is kept in the In Flight Table while transaction is in process, removed when completed.
BR-105-11.constraint: Track 2 data retained temporarily during transaction processing only

BR-105-2.statement: A device at point of interaction must not display/store card-read data except account number, expiration date, cardholder name.
BR-105-2.constraint: Only account number, expiration date, and cardholder name may be displayed/stored

BR-105-3.statement: The merchant device must not store full magnetic stripe data.
BR-105-3.constraint: Full magnetic stripe data must not be stored

BR-105-4.statement: Full card-read data including discretionary data must not be stored or reused for other purposes.
BR-105-4.constraint: Full card-read data must not be stored, replicated, or reused

BR-105-5.statement: PIN block data is not included in follow-on transactions (Completions/Reversals).
BR-105-5.constraint: Encrypted PIN Block Data must not be present

BR-105-6.statement: The default track sent to BUYPASS should be Track 2.

BR-105-8.statement: Account Number and Expiration Date must be separated by an '=' sign, not a Field Separator.
BR-105-8.constraint: Use '=' delimiter between Account Number and Expiration Date

BR-105-9.statement: Card data provided in a clearing transaction must not result from previously captured full card-read data.
BR-105-9.constraint: Clearing transaction card data must not derive from stored full card-read data

BR-106-2.statement: For MSR, card must be swiped at a POS device.
BR-106-2.constraint: Card must be swiped at a POS device

BR-106-3.statement: For EMV, the card may be dipped or tapped for contact or contactless transactions.
BR-106-3.constraint: Card may be dipped or tapped

BR-106-8.statement: Supported transactions do not require a PIN when amount is less than or equal to $50.00.

BR-106-9.statement: PINless POS Plus product supports Non-PIN debit transactions over $50.00 for specific BINs of debit networks.

BR-108-1.statement: The transactions must be card present, full mag-stripe data, or full EMV chip data.
BR-108-1.constraint: card present, full mag-stripe data, or full EMV chip data

BR-108-10.statement: eCommerce transactions including 3-D Secure Protocol (Verified by Visa, MC Secure code, Amex SafeKey, Discover ProtectBuy) are not supported.

BR-108-11.statement: STAR Single message transactions must be card present, full mag-stripe data, or full EMV chip data.
BR-108-11.constraint: Must be card present with full mag-stripe or full EMV chip data

BR-108-8.statement: Cash back is not supported for STAR Single and Dual message processing.
BR-108-8.constraint: Cash Amount must not be present/nonzero

BR-108-9.statement: Recharge, Activate, or Inquiry transactions are not supported.

BR-109-2.statement: Transactions must have the final amount same as the original authorization amount.
BR-109-2.constraint: Final amount equals original authorization amount

BR-109-4.constraint: MCC in excluded list is not processed

BR-109-5.statement: If transaction does not meet restrictions in 10.4.3/10.4.4, it is routed to card associations such as Visa, MC.
BR-109-5.condition: Transaction does not meet STAR processing restrictions
BR-109-5.constraint: Route to card associations (Visa, MC, etc.)

BR-110-2.statement: Address Verification Service requirements for credit card also apply to Signature Debit card.

BR-110-3.statement: Bill Payment/Recurring Payment Transaction requirements for credit card also apply to Signature Debit card.
BR-110-3.constraint: Bill Payment/Recurring rules from section 10.1.4 apply

BR-110-4.statement: Healthcare Auto-Substantiation Service is supported for credit, PIN debit, and Signature Debit card issuers.

BR-110-5.statement: Eligible Benefit Card requirements for credit cards also apply to Signature Debit card.

BR-110-6.statement: Partial Approval requirements for credit cards also apply to Signature Debit card.

BR-110-7.statement: Split Tender Processing requirements for credit cards also apply to Signature Debit card.

BR-110-8.statement: Qualified Healthcare Products requirements for credit cards also apply to Signature Debit card.

BR-112-1.statement: The device does not perform expiration date validation in an EBT card transaction.

BR-112-10.statement: EBT processing supports food stamps and cash benefits tender types.
BR-112-10.constraint: Tender types limited to Food stamps, Cash benefits

BR-112-3.statement: Manual entry of EBT must be supported; device must prompt for PIN regardless of Account Number entry mode.
BR-112-3.condition: Manual entry of EBT account number

BR-112-4.statement: For manually entered Account Numbers, the device must also prompt for the card's expiration date.
BR-112-4.constraint: Device must prompt for expiration date

BR-112-5.statement: If no expiration date is provided for manually entered EBT account, use 1249.

BR-112-7.statement: If retailer supports SAF EBT transactions, retailer assumes all risk for transactions submitted once connection is reestablished.

BR-112-8.statement: The PIN must be stored in an encrypted format for SAF EBT transactions.
BR-112-8.constraint: PIN must be encrypted when stored

BR-112-9.statement: The balance field must not print on the receipt; do not print zeros.
BR-112-9.constraint: Balance field must not print; zeros not printed

BR-113-1.statement: Devices must support balance inquiries by tender type.
BR-113-1.constraint: Devices must support inquiries by tender type

BR-114-1.statement: Electronic vouchers must prompt for Account Number, Approval Number, and Voucher Number.
BR-114-1.constraint: Must prompt for Account Number, Approval Number, Voucher Number

BR-114-2.statement: Stand-alone equipment must allow manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date for electronic voucher.
BR-114-2.constraint: Must allow manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date

BR-114-3.statement: If PAN is printed on receipts, it must be truncated to last four digits with X's for remaining length.
BR-114-3.constraint: Truncate to last 4 digits, pad with X's to original length

BR-114-4.statement: Device must allow entry of Approval Number received over the phone for electronic voucher.

BR-114-5.statement: Device must allow entry of Voucher Number from manual voucher ticket.

BR-114-6.statement: Supported EBT transaction types include Food Stamp Purchase, Reversal, Return, Cash Benefit Purchase, Reversal, Balance Inquiry, Electronic Voucher, Cash Back, Time-out Reversal, Void of Merchandise Return.
BR-114-6.constraint: These transaction types supported for EBT processing

BR-115-1.statement: No signature line — printing an EBT receipt.

BR-115-10.statement: Cash benefit dollar amount(s) must be printed on a Cash Benefit transaction receipt, broken down by purchase and cash back with total.
BR-115-10.constraint: Print cash benefit amounts broken down with total if both entered

BR-115-11.statement: Ending balance must be printed on the receipt for both Food Stamp and Cash Benefit transactions.
BR-115-11.condition: Food Stamp or Cash Benefit transaction

BR-115-12.statement: Beginning EBT balance may optionally be printed, calculated from ending balance and transaction amount.

BR-115-13.statement: If a particular balance is not returned by EBT authorizer, do not print a balance of zero; omit the balance.
BR-115-13.condition: Balance not returned by EBT authorizer
BR-115-13.constraint: Omit balance rather than print zero
flags: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: sentence cut off mid-text ('omit the' ends abruptly, no confirmation of exact wording')

BR-115-2.statement: The food stamp dollar amount must be printed on a Food Stamp transaction receipt.
BR-115-2.constraint: printed on a Food Stamp transaction receipt

BR-115-3.statement: Credit card receipt requirements apply to EBT receipts, except for Approved/Declined Message.
BR-115-3.constraint: Apply section 10.1.7 requirements except Approved/Declined Message

BR-115-4.statement: EBT receipts must show Tender Type, Transaction Type, Clerk ID, Voucher Number, amounts, balances, approved/declined messages, and HIP data.

BR-115-5.statement: No signature line is required on an EBT receipt.
BR-115-5.constraint: Signature line not required; optional SIGNATURE NOT REQUIRED message allowed

BR-115-6.statement: Receipt must print whether transaction is Food Stamp or Cash Benefit, and the transaction type attempted.
BR-115-6.constraint: Print tender type and transaction type

BR-115-7.statement: Clerk ID is an optional receipt requirement, may be retrieved from prompting sequence or log on/off function.
BR-115-7.constraint: Clerk ID optional, may be printed on receipt

BR-115-8.statement: Manually entered Voucher Number must appear on receipt for Food Stamp Electronic Voucher transactions only.
BR-115-8.constraint: Voucher Number must be printed on receipt

BR-115-9.statement: Food stamp dollar amount must be printed on a Food Stamp transaction receipt.

BR-116-1.statement: Approval Number and message must be printed on receipts for all approved EBT transactions.
BR-116-1.constraint: Print Approval Number and message on receipt

BR-116-2.statement: When a PIN is entered, a PIN USED message must print on the transaction receipt.
BR-116-2.constraint: Print PIN USED message on receipt

BR-116-3.statement: All declined transactions must print a receipt, indicating the reason for the decline.

BR-116-4.statement: If declined due to insufficient funds, the ending balance must be printed on the declined transaction receipt.
BR-116-4.constraint: Ending balance must be printed on receipt

BR-116-5.statement: If declined due to bad PIN, device may not prompt for PIN reentry without printing a receipt and retrying the transaction.
BR-116-5.constraint: Must print receipt before retrying transaction

BR-116-6.statement: EBT FOOD approved HIP transactions must print Incentive Eligible Amount, Incentive Earned/Returned, and Month to date Incentive Earned.
BR-116-6.condition: EBT FOOD HIP transaction is approved
BR-116-6.constraint: Print listed incentive fields on receipt

BR-116-7.statement: Incentive Earned applies to Sale transactions; Incentive Returned applies to Return transactions.
BR-116-7.condition: Transaction type is Sale or Return
BR-116-7.constraint: Use correct incentive field name per transaction type

BR-116-8.statement: Zero dollar balances should only be printed when zero is actually returned as the balance from the authorizer.
BR-116-8.constraint: Print zero balance only if authorizer actually returned zero

BR-117-1.statement: These specifications do not support Return transactions for eWIC.

BR-117-3.statement: eWIC Authorization transaction is initiated by swiping an existing eWIC card and entering PIN at POS device.
BR-117-3.constraint: Card swipe and PIN entry required to initiate

BR-117-4.statement: eWIC Balance Inquiry is initiated by swiping an existing eWIC card and entering PIN at POS device.
BR-117-4.constraint: Card swipe and PIN entry required to initiate

BR-119-1.statement: eWIC Voucher Clear info must be electronically submitted to eWIC host within Merchant's specified time limit to receive payment.
BR-119-1.constraint: Must submit within Merchant's time limit

BR-119-2.statement: eWIC Voucher Clear is an optional transaction.

BR-120-1.statement: eWIC Voucher Clear with Prompt Code 0086 is an optional transaction.

BR-120-2.statement: Specifications support eWIC Payment Type EBT WIC (50).
BR-120-2.constraint: Payment Tender Type must be EBT WIC (50) for eWIC

BR-120-3.statement: Specifications support eWIC Authorizers: Nevada (74), Kentucky (75), ACS WIC (83).
BR-120-3.constraint: Authorizer Code must be one of 74, 75, 83 for eWIC

BR-120-4.statement: eWIC Dollar Amount and eWIC Count fields added to Totals Response for eWIC processing.
BR-120-4.constraint: Totals Response includes eWIC Dollar Amount and eWIC Count

BR-121-1.statement: Prompt Code is constructed from Transaction Type Code and Card Type for eWIC processing.
BR-121-1.constraint: Prompt Code constructed from Transaction Type Code and Card Type

BR-121-2.statement: Attended self-checkout lanes are considered unattended by eWIC processors; reflected in POS Condition Code.
BR-121-2.constraint: POS Condition Code must reflect unattended status

BR-121-3.statement: EBT Data Segment referenced as Segment No. 105 for eWIC processing, conflicting with earlier Segment No. 103 reference.
BR-121-3.constraint: EBT Data Segment number stated inconsistently (103 vs 105)

BR-121-4.statement: Credit card receipt requirements apply to eWIC receipts except the Approved/Declined message.

BR-121-5.statement: eWIC card receipts must include Payment Tender Type, Transaction Type, Clerk ID, Voucher ID, amounts, balances, approved/declined messages, and benefit expiration date.
BR-121-5.constraint: Must display listed fields including WIC Benefit Expiration Date

BR-122-1.statement: EBT Program Data element supports Healthy Incentives Program evaluation of health/nutrition purchases.
BR-122-1.constraint: Data Element 164 (EBT Program Data) used for HIP

BR-122-2.statement: Incentive earned and month-to-date incentive balances are reset at the beginning of the fiscal month.

BR-122-3.statement: EBT Program Data element is used within the EBT Data Segment (Data Segment No. 103).

BR-122-4.statement: Receipt requirements from section 10.1.7 also apply to HIP receipts.

BR-124-1.statement: A stored value card cannot be used for transactions until it has been activated.
BR-124-1.constraint: Card must be activated before use

BR-124-2.statement: Activation without device requires receipt of fulfillment letter confirming shipment.

BR-124-3.statement: If card's magnetic stripe is invalid during package activation, entire package is discarded and process repeated with new package.
BR-124-3.condition: Invalid magnetic stripe during activation with predefined monetary limit
BR-124-3.constraint: Discard package and retry with new one

BR-124-4.statement: If approved Response received during activation, card is active up to predefined monetary limit.
BR-124-4.condition: Activation using device with predefined monetary limit, approved response
BR-124-4.constraint: Card active up to predefined limit

BR-124-5.statement: Under issuer-activated method, customer enters activation amount; if approved, card active up to that defined limit.
BR-124-5.condition: Activation using device with customer-defined monetary limit
BR-124-5.constraint: Card active up to entered amount

BR-124-6.statement: Clients can determine whether purchases can be made under a specific minimum amount (e.g. $1.00).

BR-124-7.statement: If an activated card is not used within authorizer's time frame, it can be deactivated at any participating client device.
BR-124-7.condition: Card unused beyond authorizer time frame

BR-125-10.statement: Blackhawk Gift card transactions should be treated as swiped transactions with entry mode '90'.

BR-125-11.statement: Activation, deactivation, or recharge/issue transactions require a prompt for the activated/recharged/issued amount.

BR-125-12.statement: When partially approved, device processes transaction for approved amount and handles remaining balance as split tender.
BR-125-12.constraint: Process approved amount, remainder as split tender

BR-125-13.statement: Partially approved transactions return Response Code (Element No. 83) value of F.

BR-125-2.statement: Device does not perform expiration date validation in a stored value card transaction.

BR-125-3.statement: If magnetic stripe unreadable, POS should prompt user to swipe card again up to three times.
BR-125-3.constraint: Prompt swipe retry up to 3 times

BR-125-4.statement: When manual entry allowed and stripe unreadable after 3 attempts, prompt for Account Number and Expiration Date (MMYY).
BR-125-4.condition: Manual entry allowed, stripe unreadable after 3 attempts
BR-125-4.constraint: Prompt manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date in MMYY format

BR-125-5.statement: First Data Premium Gift Card has no embossed expiration date; default value of 1249 is sent.
BR-125-5.condition: First Data Premium Gift Card used

BR-125-6.statement: First Data Premium Gift Card has a 16-digit Account Number.

BR-125-7.statement: If manual entry not allowed and stripe unreadable after 3 attempts, display message to clerk and end transaction.
BR-125-7.condition: Manual entry not allowed, stripe unreadable after 3 attempts

BR-125-8.statement: If manual entry used, this is indicated on receipt and journal by an asterisk (*).

BR-125-9.statement: Bar Code Scanned Gift card should be treated as manually entered transaction with Account Number and Expiration Date; entry mode '01'.
BR-125-9.constraint: Entry mode = 01, treated as manual entry

BR-126-1.statement: If Approved Amount is partial, POS device must prompt for payment of remaining balance due.
BR-126-1.constraint: POS device must prompt for remaining balance payment

BR-126-2.statement: Approval Number contains the card balance if returned by the issuer.
BR-126-2.constraint: Approval Number field holds that balance

BR-128-1.statement: this transaction is received — the card issuer unlocks the SVC account.
BR-128-1.constraint: the card issuer unlocks the SVC account

BR-128-10.statement: Merchandise Return: POS device must subtract amount from SVC bucket and add transaction to SVC quantity.
BR-128-10.constraint: Subtract from SVC bucket, add to SVC quantity

BR-128-11.statement: Account Verification (Preauthorization Activation) is an additional transaction type supported for InComm.

BR-128-2.statement: Purchase/Capture: if approved, issuer deducts purchase amount from card's balance; otherwise declined response sent.
BR-128-2.constraint: Deduct purchase amount from card balance

BR-128-5.statement: Authorization Only places a lock on the card; client decides lock duration.

BR-128-6.statement: Authorization Only Response contains the card's balance and authorization number.
BR-128-6.constraint: Response includes balance and authorization number

BR-128-7.statement: Authorization Only Reversal used if device fails or communication problem occurs after approved Authorization Only Response.
BR-128-7.condition: Device failure or communication problem after approved Authorization Only Response
BR-128-7.constraint: Send Authorization Only Reversal with client-set amount

BR-128-9.statement: Merchandise Return adds given amount to card's balance.

BR-129-1.statement: Deactivation amount in transaction request must match the account balance.
BR-129-1.condition: Non-First Data Standard Gift Card Deactivation transaction
BR-129-1.constraint: Deactivation amount must equal account balance

BR-129-10.statement: Balance Merge transaction can be repeated until all balances merged to a single card.
BR-129-10.condition: More than two cards need merging
BR-129-10.constraint: Repeat transaction until single card holds merged balance

BR-129-11.statement: Replace Card transaction transfers balance of lost/stolen/damaged card to a new account number.
BR-129-11.constraint: Balance transferred to new account number

BR-129-12.statement: Old card's balance is reduced to $0.00 after Replace Card transaction.

BR-129-13.statement: Balance Inquiry transaction should not change SVC quantity or amount totals.

BR-129-2.statement: Cash out amount must be greater than $0.00 and equal to or less than the account balance.
BR-129-2.condition: First Data Premium Gift Card Cash Out transaction
BR-129-2.constraint: Amount must be >$0.00 and <= account balance

BR-129-3.statement: After cash out, account balance is taken to $0.00 and amount used is returned in Approved Amount field.
BR-129-3.constraint: Approved Amount field returns amount used to zero balance

BR-129-4.statement: First Data Premium Gift Card has a 16-digit Account Number.

BR-129-5.statement: POS device must add this count to the SV1 count total.
BR-129-5.constraint: Add count to SV1 count total

BR-129-6.statement: POS device must subtract this amount from the SV1 amount total.
BR-129-6.constraint: Subtract amount from SV1 amount total

BR-129-7.statement: Added amount in Recharge/Issue Card transaction cannot cause balance to exceed original card value.
BR-129-7.constraint: Resulting balance must not exceed original card value

BR-129-8.statement: Maximum number of cards involved in Balance Merge transaction is two.

BR-129-9.statement: Remaining card's balance is reduced to $0.00 after Balance Merge transaction.

BR-130-1.statement: No signature line — printing a stored value card receipt.
BR-130-1.constraint: printing a stored value card receipt

BR-130-10.statement: PAN printed on receipts must be truncated to last four digits, with X's equal to length of truncated digits.
BR-130-10.constraint: Truncate to last 4 digits, pad with X's to original Account Number length

BR-130-11.statement: Truncation of Account Number is required on all customer-activated transactions.

BR-130-12.statement: Last four digits of 16-digit Account Number truncated on First Data Premium Gift Card receipts only, replaced by four X's.
BR-130-12.condition: First Data Premium Gift Card receipt
BR-130-12.constraint: Last 4 digits replaced by four X's

BR-130-13.statement: Balance Merge or Replacement/Balance Transfer receipt preferably shows Account Number for card with final balance.
BR-130-13.condition: Balance Merge or Replacement/Balance Transfer transaction
BR-130-13.constraint: Receipt should show Account Number of card with final balance

BR-130-14.statement: Support added for device to capture and send customer's ZIP Code in closed loop prepaid card transaction.
BR-130-14.constraint: Device may capture and send ZIP Code

BR-130-2.statement: this transaction is received — the card issuer unlocks the stored value card account.
BR-130-2.constraint: the card issuer unlocks the stored value card account

BR-130-6.statement: Account Verification (Preauthorization Activation) Transaction is only supported for InComm cards.
BR-130-6.constraint: Only InComm cards support this transaction type

BR-130-7.statement: Recharge amount must print on all approved stored value card receipts.

BR-130-8.statement: Remaining balance prints on all approved and declined stored value card receipts, returned as Approval Number.
BR-130-8.condition: Approved or declined stored value card transaction
BR-130-8.constraint: Remaining balance printed, sourced from Approval Number field

BR-130-9.statement: No signature line is required on stored value card receipts; SIGNATURE NOT REQUIRED message optional.

BR-131-1.statement: Premium Gift Card follow-on transactions must be full Track 2 Data.

BR-131-2.statement: ZIP Code value is not validated by the issuer and has no bearing on approval or decline.
BR-131-2.constraint: ZIP Code used for reporting purposes only

BR-131-4.statement: SVS follow-on transaction card data can be either full or partial Track 2 Data.
BR-131-4.constraint: Full or partial Track 2 Data allowed

BR-131-5.statement: First Data Premium Gift Card (BIN 601056) follow-on using token or 601056* card number may be sent as key entered transaction.
BR-131-5.condition: BIN 601056 follow-on transaction using token or 601056* card number
BR-131-5.constraint: May be sent as key entered transaction

BR-131-6.statement: All other First Data Premium Gift Card follow-on transactions must be full Track 2 Data.
BR-131-6.condition: First Data Premium Gift Card follow-on transaction, not BIN 601056 token case

BR-131-7.statement: Partial Track 2 Data is PAN followed by '=' then 4-digit expiration date (YYMM), no further discretionary data.

BR-132-1.statement: SCAN (ETC) and ECA/TeleCheck require MICR data when swiped data entry is used.
BR-132-1.condition: Swiped data entry used, Check processor = SCAN (ETC) or ECA/TeleCheck

BR-132-2.statement: SCAN (ETC) and ECA/TeleCheck require driver's license data and State Code when manual entry is used.
BR-132-2.condition: Manual data entry used, Check processor = SCAN (ETC) or ECA/TeleCheck
BR-132-2.constraint: Driver's license data and alphabetical State Code are required

BR-132-3.statement: Certegy requires driver's license data, State Code, and date of birth when manual entry is used.
BR-132-3.condition: Manual data entry used, Check processor = Certegy (Formerly Telecredit)
BR-132-3.constraint: Driver's license, State Code, and date of birth are required

BR-132-4.statement: Only Purchase transaction type is supported for check processing.

BR-132-5.statement: No receipt is required for non-ECA/TeleCheck service processing; response displayed on device only.
BR-132-5.constraint: No receipt required; Approval/Decline shown on device only

BR-133-1.statement: A merchant authorization and check writer copy must be printed for each approved ECA/TeleCheck transaction.
BR-133-1.constraint: Print merchant copy and check writer copy of authorization

BR-133-2.statement: The check writer must sign the merchant's copy before the transaction is considered complete.
BR-133-2.constraint: Customer signature required on merchant copy

BR-133-3.statement: Once signed, the paper check must be voided and returned to the check writer at POS.
BR-133-3.constraint: Void check and return to check writer

BR-133-4.statement: Receipt must include Merchant Name, address, phone, Terminal ID, Merchant ID, Trace ID, Approval Number, Check Amount, and related fields.
BR-133-4.condition: For each approved ECA/TeleCheck transaction receipt copy
BR-133-4.constraint: All listed required fields must appear

BR-133-5.statement: Line for customer's signature must be printed below the ECA/TeleCheck Authorization notice.
BR-133-5.constraint: Signature line must be present below authorization notice

BR-133-6.statement: Additional recommended fields include Customer Telephone Number if prompted, Custom Field prompt/data, and Merchant Trace ID.
BR-133-6.constraint: Include Customer Telephone Number and related recommended fields

BR-134-1.statement: The following information must be printed on each copy of Version 2 Denial Receipt.
BR-134-1.constraint: printed on each copy of Version 2 Denial Receipt

BR-134-2.statement: Merchant receipt must print customer's name, street address, and state/ZIP Code lines when ECA/TeleCheck requires it.
BR-134-2.constraint: Print customer name, street address, state and ZIP Code lines

BR-134-3.statement: Denial Record Receipt must print Denial Record Number, Check Amount, NACHA Language, and TeleCheck Phone Number if cashiers are not using courtesy cards.
BR-134-3.constraint: Must print Denial Record Number, Check Amount, NACHA Language, TeleCheck Phone Number

BR-134-4.statement: Denial Record Number is used with all TeleCheck products.

BR-135-1.statement: Device does not perform expiration date validation in a loyalty card transaction.

BR-135-2.statement: Manual entry is allowed on a loyalty card transaction after three failed swipe attempts.
BR-135-2.condition: Device unable to read magnetic stripe after three attempts
BR-135-2.constraint: Device prompts for manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date (MMYY)

BR-636-2.constraint: Visa Gateway ID field is mandatory

BR-638-1.statement: Void/Completion transactions must use same PAN Entry Mode as original, except code 02 replaces 90.
BR-638-1.condition: Transaction is a Void or Completion referencing original with PAN Entry Mode 90
BR-638-1.constraint: Use PAN Entry Mode code 02 instead of 90

BR-638-2.statement: Entry Mode 10 (Credential on File) not applicable to first transaction verifying or storing credentials.
BR-638-2.constraint: PAN Entry Mode 10 must not be used

BR-638-3.statement: For Discover, POS Entry Mode 10 must not be present for QR Code/Bar Code/Payment Code transactions.
BR-638-3.condition: Card Type = Discover, transaction type = QR/Bar Code/Payment Code
BR-638-3.constraint: PAN Entry Mode must not be 10

BR-638-4.statement: For Discover, POS Entry Mode 10 must not be present for card sales with info stored by issuer or digital wallet.
BR-638-4.condition: Card Type = Discover, card info stored by Issuer or in digital wallet
BR-638-4.constraint: PAN Entry Mode must not be 10

BR-638-5.statement: For Discover, Entry Mode 82 must not be assigned when cardholder uses stored card account information.
BR-638-5.condition: Card Type = Discover, cardholder uses stored card info
BR-638-5.constraint: PAN Entry Mode must not be 82; must use 10 instead

BR-638-6.statement: Discover Credential on File transactions must use POS Entry Mode value of 10.
BR-638-6.condition: Card Type = Discover, Credential on File transaction

BR-638-8.statement: Entry Mode 10 applicable to Visa, MasterCard, Discover Credit, and Amex transactions based on stored credentials.
BR-638-8.condition: Credit COF transaction type for listed card types
BR-638-8.constraint: PAN Entry Mode 10 applies, including subsequent Debit Completions/Reversals from Credit COF

BR-639-2.statement: For EMV Contact and Contactless, valid PIN Entry Capability Mode code is 1, not 8.
BR-639-2.condition: EMV Contact and Contactless capability present
BR-639-2.constraint: code must be 1, code 8 reserved for Contactless MSR only

BR-639-3.statement: If no Contactless MSR attached and PIN debit feature enabled, use code 1.
BR-639-3.condition: No Contactless MSR; PIN debit feature enabled
BR-639-3.constraint: Terminal PIN Entry Capability Mode code = 1

BR-639-4.statement: If no Contactless MSR attached and PIN debit feature disabled, use code 2.
BR-639-4.condition: No Contactless MSR; PIN debit feature disabled
BR-639-4.constraint: Terminal PIN Entry Capability Mode code = 2

BR-639-5.statement: PIN Entry Capability Mode code 3 applies only to MasterCard Mobile POS transactions.

BR-64-1.statement: Restaurant credit card sales are terminal-capture and initiated as POS Authorization Only transactions.
BR-64-1.constraint: Initiated as POS Authorization Only transactions

BR-64-2.statement: Pending sales are marked to send and uploaded as POS Purchase/Capture transactions when batch is closed.
BR-64-2.constraint: Pending sales uploaded as POS Purchase/Capture transactions including original approval number

BR-64-7.statement: Restaurant Debit, EBT, and gift sales are host-capture and initiated as POS Purchase/Capture transactions.

BR-650-5.statement: NYCE CVV2/CVC2/CID response codes include not processed, matched, did not match, not on card, no keys/not certified.
BR-650-5.constraint: Code values: P, M, N, S, U (NYCE)
flags: generic code mapping, no field link stated

BR-652-1.statement: Table ID fixed value is 008 for Loyalty Information Version 1.

BR-652-2.statement: Maximum Length for Loyalty Information additional information is 229.

BR-652-3.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 010 indicates Failed.

BR-652-4.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 900 indicates System failure.

BR-652-5.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 120 indicates Duplicate card.

BR-652-6.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 210 indicates Insufficient points in account.

BR-653-1.statement: Visa Product Result Information Maximum Length is 2.

BR-653-2.statement: Loyalty Information Version 2 Maximum Length is 60.

BR-653-3.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 010 indicates Failed.

BR-653-4.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 900 indicates System failure.

BR-653-5.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 100 indicates Account not found.

BR-653-6.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 120 indicates Duplicate card.

BR-653-7.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 140 indicates Loyalty card is expired.

BR-653-8.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 210 indicates Insufficient points in account.

BR-653-9.statement: Loyalty Processing Status code 320 indicates transaction found but data does not match.
BR-653-9.constraint: Transaction found, but data does not match

BR-654-3.statement: Discover Network Retrieval Reference Number Table ID is fixed value 012 with maximum length 015.

BR-656-3.statement: Card Accepted As value 020 indicates transaction processed as credit card or Signature Debit routed to Credit (CC) Authorizer.

BR-656-4.statement: Card Accepted As value 011 indicates transaction processed as debit card or Signature Debit routed to Debit (DB) Authorizer.

BR-657-1.statement: Field is conditional in response to Card Not Present Pinless eComm/Mobile Commerce transactions.
BR-657-1.condition: Card Not Present Pinless eComm/Mobile Commerce transaction

BR-657-4.statement: Visa Spend Qualified Indicator Table ID has fixed value 019 and fixed length 001.

BR-66-1.statement: An electronic journal is not provided by BUYPASS but can be designed/implemented by a customer.

BR-66-2.statement: Electronic journal should contain all approved transactions, excluding authorization only transactions.

BR-66-3.statement: Local totals accumulate from electronic journal transactions, including authorization only transactions.

BR-66-5.statement: Electronic journal is structured as a circular queue accessed by a designated key per device type.
BR-66-5.constraint: Journal structure is a circular queue keyed by device type.

BR-660-2.statement: Discover supports only CAVV Result values 0, 1, and 2.

BR-660-3.statement: Visa supports all CAVV Result values listed (Blank, 0-9, A-D).

BR-662-2.statement: Transaction Identifier (Table ID 028) sent back only for transactions with Credential on File Indicator = 'I' or 'C'.
BR-662-2.constraint: Transaction Identifier included in response, else omitted

BR-662-3.statement: Merchant should store Transaction Identifier for Visa and Amex merchant-initiated Credential on File transactions.
BR-662-3.condition: Visa/Amex merchant-initiated Credential on File transaction
BR-662-3.constraint: Merchant must store the returned Transaction Identifier value

BR-663-1.statement: Merchant Advice Code is currently supported only for MasterCard network.

BR-664-4.statement: MasterCard may add new merchant advice codes at any time; merchant should accept any new values.
BR-664-4.constraint: Merchant must accept new Merchant Advice Code values

BR-665-2.statement: Agreement ID is currently supported only for VISA network.
BR-665-2.constraint: Only VISA network supports Agreement ID

BR-665-3.statement: DAF Indicator is currently supported only for Visa network.

BR-665-5.statement: Host-based Purchase Restrictions applicable only to Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 and MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV transactions.
BR-665-5.condition: Transaction = Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 or MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV

BR-666-1.statement: Sub-Table Data contains Cardholder name result codes received from Visa if merchant sends Table ID 34 (NVS Information) in segment 111.
BR-666-1.condition: Merchant sends Table ID 34 (NVS Information) in Variable Information segment 111 for a verification transaction
BR-666-1.constraint: Sub-Table Data (3 bytes) contains name match result codes

BR-667-10.statement: Name match code examples currently applicable to Visa only.

BR-667-4.statement: Cardholder Phone result code is applicable only to Visa.
BR-667-4.constraint: Field applies only for Visa transactions

BR-669-1.statement: Account Funding Source is received only if sent in network response and Visa Account Flag sub-table 20 = Y.
BR-669-1.condition: Visa Account Flag in Merchant Supplementary Data sub-table 20 = Y
BR-669-1.constraint: Account Funding Source included in response

BR-669-4.statement: Transaction Link Action Indicator value 1 means customer did not provide the TLID.
BR-669-4.constraint: Customer did not provide TLID per Mastercard/Maestro

BR-670-4.statement: Code 2 - TLID provided by customer is unmatched; Mastercard/Maestro responds with corresponding TLID in segment 112, table ID 38.
BR-670-4.condition: TLID provided by customer is unmatched
BR-670-4.constraint: Mastercard/Maestro responds with corresponding TLID in segment 112, table ID 38

BR-670-5.statement: Code 3 - Mastercard/Maestro unable to match lifecycle message to any original message; responds with corresponding TLID in segment 112, table ID 38.
BR-670-5.condition: Mastercard/Maestro unable to match lifecycle message to original message
BR-670-5.constraint: Responds with corresponding TLID in segment 112, table ID 38

BR-671-2.statement: Authentication Data Quality Indicator valid values are 1 (does not meet) or 2 (meets) Visa Secure authentication data quality requirements.

BR-671-3.statement: Authentication Data Quality Indicator is currently supported for the Visa network only.

BR-672-1.statement: BUYPASS will echo Merchant Tran ID in responses only if Merchant Supplementary Data subfield 25 is set to 'Y'.
BR-672-1.constraint: Merchant Tran ID is echoed in response

BR-672-4.statement: Voyager Restriction Code is only included if subfield 28 of Merchant Supplementary Data is populated with 'Y'.
BR-672-4.constraint: Voyager Restriction Code field is included

BR-673-2.statement: Table Data is a one-byte field indicating category of Visa 'declined' response code, values 1-3.

BR-683-4.statement: EBT Program Data element format example can contain either one or two sets of subelements depending on request.
BR-683-4.constraint: May include one or two subelement sets

BR-687-2.statement: Account Number is required to be 16 digits using First Data Premium Gift Card ISO assigned BIN.
BR-687-2.constraint: Account Number must be 16 digits with assigned BIN

BR-687-3.statement: PVKI field is not currently used by the First Data Premium Gift Card system.

BR-687-4.statement: Start Sentinel character is not displayed as part of Track data and is cut from the packet.
BR-687-4.constraint: Start Sentinel removed before packet transmission

BR-688-3.statement: If merchant sends 56 bytes of token data, BUYPASS considers it as token data block A and block B.
BR-688-3.condition: Merchant sends 56 bytes of Cryptogram Token Data
BR-688-3.constraint: Treated as token data block A and block B

BR-688-4.statement: If merchant sends only 28 bytes of token data, BUYPASS considers it as token data block A.
BR-688-4.condition: Merchant sends 28 bytes of Cryptogram Token Data
BR-688-4.constraint: Treated as token data block A only

BR-697-1.statement: Tag/length/value data is ANSB format, up to 999, with EMV chip tag fields included as applicable.
BR-697-1.constraint: Field length N3, example 0nnn; tag/length/value up to ANSB 999

BR-697-2.statement: Data in the EMV chip data example is BCD Packed/Hex Nibbles in format 'nn'.
BR-697-2.constraint: Data encoded as BCD Packed/Hex Nibbles
flags: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: source text reads 'BCK Packed/Hex Nibbles' not 'BCD Packed/Hex Nibbles'

BR-701-1.statement: EMVYES code sent only in an EMV Transaction request, indicates device able to receive EMV Table Data.
BR-701-1.constraint: Code value EMVYES indicates device can receive EMV Table Data

BR-701-2.statement: EMVNOT code sent only in an EMV Transaction request, indicates device unable to receive EMV Table Data.
BR-701-2.constraint: Code value EMVNOT indicates device cannot receive EMV Table Data

BR-701-3.statement: If EMV Table Data field is included in authorization response, device echoes it back on subsequent advice or batch upload request.
BR-701-3.constraint: Device must echo field back on subsequent advice/batch upload request

BR-702-2.statement: Maximum Length field identifies the CARC value returned by Visa in Bit No. 44.8 of the response.
BR-702-2.constraint: Value sourced from Visa Bit 44.8 response
flags: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: description text follows 'Maximum Length n6 Len.: 1' but may describe overall CARC field, not Maximum Length specifically

BR-711-1.statement: For Verified-by-Visa only scenario, CAVV applies, TAVV not applicable.
BR-711-1.constraint: CAVV present (Table ID 035), TAVV not applicable

BR-711-3.statement: For Verified-by-Visa and Digital Wallet scenario, both CAVV Revised Format and TAVV Cryptogram apply.
BR-711-3.constraint: CAVV (Data Element 195) and TAVV Cryptogram (Data Element 237) both present

BR-711-4.statement: SafeKey transactions from merchants sent with indicator 'SK' followed by 56 bytes of SafeKey data in base64 format.
BR-711-4.constraint: Indicator 'SK' plus 56 bytes base64-encoded SafeKey data

BR-712-2.statement: Merchants should use UCAF data field for MasterCard AAV cryptogram and TAVV field for Token/DSRP cryptograms.
BR-712-2.constraint: AAV goes in UCAF (Segment 111 table ID 36); Token/DSRP cryptogram goes in TAVV (Segment 123 Element 237)

BR-712-3.statement: MasterCard SecureCode requires merchants to install 3-D Secure v1.0.2 (or better) compliant Merchant Server Plug-In software.

BR-712-4.statement: American Express Safekey is not available for OptBlue merchants.

BR-713-1.statement: If no amount is due when storing credentials first time, send $0.00 Account Verification with Value 'I' (Initial) in DE 111, Table ID 32, Sub table 08.
BR-713-1.condition: No amount due, storing credentials first time
BR-713-1.constraint: Send $0.00 Account Verification with Value 'I' in DE111 Table ID 32 Sub table 08

BR-713-10.statement: For all card types, DE111 Table ID 32 Sub table 08 should have value 'C' for Subsequent Credential on File in MIT recurring transaction.

BR-713-15.statement: Visa/Amex Transaction ID (DE111 Table ID 44) and Discover Network Reference Number (DE111 Table ID 15) should be included in subsequent MIT request.
BR-713-15.constraint: Include stored Transaction ID/Reference Number in DE111

BR-713-5.statement: For Unscheduled Merchant Initiated or Cardholder initiated Credential-on-File transactions, no recurring or installment indicators are required.
BR-713-5.condition: Unscheduled Merchant Initiated or Cardholder initiated COF transaction

BR-713-6.statement: Visa/Amex Transaction ID (DE 112, Table ID 28) and Discover Network Reference number (DE 112, Table ID 12) from response should be stored for subsequent MIT COF transactions.
BR-713-6.constraint: Store Transaction ID/Reference number for subsequent MIT transactions

BR-713-8.statement: For MasterCard, Merchant must send MIT/CIT category and subcategory data with valid value for initial transaction when storing credential on file.
BR-713-8.condition: Card Type = MasterCard, storing credential on file
BR-713-8.constraint: Send MIT/CIT category/subcategory data per DE111 Table ID 56 Sub Table ID 09

BR-714-1.statement: First Authorization Amount (DE 111, Table ID 45) should be included for Discover MIT transactions
BR-714-1.constraint: Include First Authorization Amount, Table ID 45

BR-714-11.statement: Visa/Amex Transaction ID (Table ID 44) and Discover Network Reference Number (Table ID 15) should be included in subsequent request
BR-714-11.constraint: Include Table ID 44 and Table ID 15

BR-714-12.statement: Stored Credential Additional Data (Table ID 56, Sub Table 01 and 08) should be included for Discover MIT installment transactions
BR-714-12.constraint: Include Table ID 56 Sub Table 01 and 08

BR-714-13.statement: Installment Payment Type (Table ID 49, Sub Table 13) should be included for Discover MIT installment transactions

BR-714-14.statement: Discover Soft Descriptor Merchant name (Table ID 047) must contain third party payment provider and underlying retailer name as 'Third Party*Merchant name'
BR-714-14.condition: Discover third party payment provider transaction
BR-714-14.constraint: Format 'Third Party*Merchant name', e.g. XYZ*A SMALL CO

BR-714-15.statement: Discover Soft Descriptor Merchant location (Table ID 057, 058, 059) should include address of underlying retailer for third party providers
BR-714-15.condition: Discover third party payment provider transaction

BR-714-16.statement: Discover SIC information (Table ID 007) should be the SIC/MCC code of the underlying retailer/merchant
BR-714-16.condition: Discover third party payment provider transaction
BR-714-16.constraint: SIC code = underlying retailer's SIC/MCC code

BR-714-2.statement: Stored Credential Additional Data (Table ID 56, Sub Table 01-08) required for Discover MIT if card issued in India and amount above $52
BR-714-2.condition: Discover MIT, card issued in India, amount > $52
BR-714-2.constraint: Include Stored Credential Additional Data Sub Table ID 01 to 08

BR-714-3.statement: MasterCard must send MIT/CIT category and subcategory data for recurring transactions (Standing order or Subscription)
BR-714-3.constraint: Send valid MIT/CIT category/subcategory, Table ID 56 Sub Table 09

BR-714-4.statement: Visa must send Stored Credential Additional Data for Recurring payments for cards issued in India
BR-714-4.condition: Card Type = Visa, card issued in India, recurring payment
BR-714-4.constraint: Include Table ID 56 Sub Table ID 01 to 13

BR-714-6.statement: POS Additional Data (Table ID 32, Sub Table 08) must have value 'C' for Subsequent Credential on File for all card types

BR-714-7.statement: POS Entry Mode value '10' must be submitted in Table ID 05 for all card types in installment MIT

BR-715-10.statement: Stored Credential Additional Data (Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 01-08) should be included for Discover MIT if card issued in India and amount above $52.
BR-715-10.condition: Discover MIT, card issued in India, amount > $52
BR-715-10.constraint: Include Table ID 56 Sub Table ID 01-08

BR-715-11.statement: MasterCard must send MIT/CIT category and subcategory data for MIT Unscheduled credential on file transactions per Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 09.
BR-715-11.condition: Card Type = MasterCard, MIT Unscheduled credential on file
BR-715-11.constraint: Send via Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 09

BR-715-12.statement: Discover Delayed Card Sale transactions require Table ID 16 Delayed Card Sale Indicator = 'D'.
BR-715-12.condition: Card Type = Discover, Delayed Card Sale

BR-715-13.statement: Discover No Show Charge transactions require Table ID 17 No Show Charge Indicator = 'N'.
BR-715-13.condition: Card Type = Discover, No Show Charge

BR-715-19.statement: MasterCard must send MIT/CIT category/subcategory data for CIT Standing order and Subscription transactions.
BR-715-19.condition: Card Type = MasterCard, CIT Standing order or Subscription

BR-715-3.statement: MasterCard must send MIT/CIT category and subcategory data for MIT Installment transactions per Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 09.
BR-715-3.condition: Card Type = MasterCard, transaction = MIT Installment
BR-715-3.constraint: Send MIT/CIT category/subcategory via Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 09

BR-715-6.statement: For all card types, Table ID 32 Sub table ID 08 should be 'C' for Subsequent Credential on File.

BR-715-7.statement: POS Entry Mode value '10' must be submitted in Table ID 05 for all card types.

BR-715-8.statement: Visa/Amex Transaction ID (Table ID 44) and Discover Network Reference Number (Table ID 15) should be included in subsequent request.
BR-715-8.constraint: Include Table ID 44 (Visa/Amex) or Table ID 15 (Discover)

BR-715-9.statement: First Authorization Amount (Table ID 45) should be included for Discover MIT transactions.

BR-716-1.statement: For Visa cards issued in India, merchant must send Stored Credential Additional Data for Recurring payments.
BR-716-1.condition: Visa card issued in India, Recurring payment
BR-716-1.constraint: Send Stored Credentials Additional Data, Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 01-13

BR-716-12.statement: MasterCard merchants must send MIT/CIT category/subcategory data for CIT unscheduled credential on file transactions.
BR-716-12.condition: MasterCard card type, CIT unscheduled credential on file transaction
BR-716-12.constraint: Send valid MIT/CIT category/subcategory per Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 09

BR-716-7.statement: MasterCard merchants must send MIT/CIT category and subcategory data for CIT Installment transactions.
BR-716-7.condition: MasterCard card type, CIT Installment transaction
BR-716-7.constraint: Send valid MIT/CIT category/subcategory per Table ID 56, Sub Table ID 09

BR-716-9.statement: For all card types, Table ID 32 Sub table ID 08 should have value 'C' for Subsequent Credential on File.

BR-717-6.statement: For Initial Transaction Request with PKI Encryption and Tokenization, 2 zeros plus first 6 bytes of Merchant Number precede data.
BR-717-6.condition: Initial Transaction Request, PKI Encryption and Tokenization method
BR-717-6.constraint: Prefix with 2 zeros followed by first 6 bytes of BUYPASS Merchant Number

BR-718-3.statement: Encrypted data for a manually entered PAN (EDATA identifier 3) should be followed by <fs> and MMYY unencrypted expiration date.
BR-718-3.constraint: Append <fs> and MMYY unencrypted expiration date

BR-718-4.statement: For EDATA identifier 4 (Token Only), EDATA is unencrypted data (Track1, Track2, or manually-keyed PAN).

BR-718-6.statement: For TA-VE, EDATA is processor code, colon, Encrypted Track Data; manual PAN followed by <fs> and MMYY expiration.
BR-718-6.constraint: EDATA format: processor code : Encrypted Track Data (+<fs>+MMYY for manual PAN)

BR-719-2.statement: For a TransArmor Token Only transaction declined because BUYPASS cannot retrieve the token, decline code 4M is returned.
BR-719-2.condition: TransArmor Token Only transaction cannot retrieve token for PAN

BR-728-1.statement: Transaction must be from a participating acquirer and a card not present transaction (credential on file, instalment, or recurring payment).
BR-728-1.constraint: Must be credential on file, instalment payment, or recurring payment

BR-728-3.statement: Participating merchant should send Account Updater Request Indicator (segment 111, Table ID 060, Sub table ID 01) for Instalment, Recurring, and Credential on File transactions.
BR-728-3.condition: Instalment, Recurring, or Credential on File transaction
BR-728-3.constraint: Send Account Updater Request Indicator in Variable Information segment 111

BR-730-2.statement: Incremental Auth functionality is mandatory for Discover and not limited by MCC.

BR-730-3.statement: All IA transaction types should contain Incremental Auth Data in Variable Information segment 111; mandatory for Discover.
BR-730-3.condition: Transaction type = any IA transaction type

BR-730-4.statement: Incremental Auth Data contains the Transaction ID which must be unique per terminal to any open Incremental Auth purchase.
BR-730-4.constraint: Transaction ID must be unique per terminal for open IA purchase

BR-78-4.statement: BUYPASS does not run a settlement until 2:00 p.m., affecting when transactions settle.
BR-78-4.condition: Merchant's end-of-business day occurs other than 2:00 p.m.
BR-78-4.constraint: Settlement occurs at 2:00 p.m. on following day

BR-81-1.statement: Dates up to and including December 2049 (Format: 1249) are assumed to be in the twenty-first century.

BR-81-10.statement: Device should prompt user to swipe card up to three times if magnetic stripe unreadable.

BR-81-11.statement: After three failed swipe attempts, device should prompt for manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date (Format: MMYY).
BR-81-11.constraint: Prompt manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date

BR-81-12.statement: If manual entry is used, an asterisk (*) precedes the Account Number on receipt and journal.
BR-81-12.constraint: Asterisk shown before Account Number on receipt/journal

BR-81-2.statement: Default track sent to host should be Track 2 if the device supports Track 2.

BR-81-3.statement: If device cannot read Track 2, device should send unaltered Track 1 before attempting manual entry.
BR-81-3.constraint: Send unaltered Track 1 before manual entry

BR-81-4.statement: If a Pre-Auth transaction is approved offline, full track data must be sent.
BR-81-4.constraint: Full track data must be sent

BR-81-5.statement: If a Sale transaction is approved offline, full track data must be sent.
BR-81-5.constraint: Full track data must be sent

BR-81-6.statement: Track 1 data is mandatory for all MSR and MSD Amex AFD transactions, preferred for other Amex transactions.

BR-81-7.statement: If AFD transaction contains encrypted data in TransArmor Encryption Block, Track 1 data must be present with Encryption Target as Track 1.
BR-81-7.condition: AFD transaction with TransArmor Encryption Block
BR-81-7.constraint: Track 1 data present with Encryption Target = Track 1

BR-81-8.statement: For all other card types, default track should be Track 2; if unreadable, send unaltered Track 1 on initial transaction before manual entry.

BR-81-9.statement: All follow-up transactions should use truncated Track 2 or truncated Track 2 facsimile.

BR-83-1.statement: Credit card processing supports Purchase/Capture, Purchase Reversal, Authorization Only, Merchandise Return, Time-out Reversal, Mail/Phone transactions, Void, Balance Inquiry, Partial Approval, Authorization Only Reversal.
BR-83-1.constraint: Only listed transaction types supported for credit card processing

BR-83-2.statement: Customer-activated terminals support only Purchase/Capture, Authorization Only, Time-out Reversal, Partial Approval, Authorization Only Reversal.
BR-83-2.constraint: Limited subset of transaction types supported

BR-84-1.statement: Partial approval info returned when Partial Approval Indicator value is 1.
BR-84-1.constraint: Response includes Response Code F, Approved Amount, possible card balance

BR-84-2.statement: Response Code value F indicates approval with partial amount approved.

BR-84-3.statement: Approved Amount contains the approved partial amount; POS must prompt for remaining balance.
BR-84-3.constraint: Approved Amount = partial amount; POS prompts for remainder

BR-84-4.statement: Card balance, if returned by issuer, is in the Additional Information Data Segment.

BR-84-5.statement: Partial Approval transactions are supported for POS Purchase, POS Authorization Only, CAT Authorization Only.
BR-84-5.constraint: Only these transaction types support Partial Approval

BR-84-7.statement: BUYPASS supports reversal of a partially approved original authorization, NOT a partial reversal of an original transaction.

BR-85-1.statement: All approved and partially approved authorization transactions must be either cleared or reversed.

BR-85-2.statement: Acquirers must ensure merchants process authorization reversals for card-present transactions within 24 hours.
BR-85-2.condition: Card-present transaction cancelled or submitted in error

BR-85-3.statement: Card-absent merchants are allowed up to 72 hours to process required partial or full authorization reversals.

BR-85-5.statement: Recommended to send SIC Information Code '5542' for CAT (outside) transactions using velocity processing.

BR-85-6.statement: Recommended to send SIC Information Code '5541' for inside transactions using velocity processing.

BR-85-7.statement: Authorization Only Reversal applies to POS Authorization Only (Transaction Type code '3').
BR-85-7.constraint: reversal allowed for POS Authorization Only

BR-85-8.statement: Authorization Only Reversal applies to CAT Authorization Only (Transaction Type code '5').
BR-85-8.constraint: reversal allowed for CAT Authorization Only

BR-86-1.statement: BUYPASS processes all Purchase/Capture transactions when Response Code is approval, regardless of AVS information.
BR-86-1.constraint: Transaction processed regardless of AVS information

BR-86-3.statement: Bill payment/recurring and installment payment transactions must be identified by a Variable Information Indicator in Segment No. 111.
BR-86-3.condition: Transaction is bill payment/recurring or installment payment
BR-86-3.constraint: Variable Information Indicator must identify transaction type

BR-86-4.statement: Point-of-Sale Entry Mode must be populated correctly when an RFID receiver is connected, even if swiped or manually keyed.
BR-86-4.condition: RFID receiver is connected to point-of-sale device or controller
BR-86-4.constraint: Point-of-Sale Entry Mode (within Element 113) must be correctly populated on all transactions

BR-87-1.statement: Eligible benefit cards are identified by a 9-digit BIN.
BR-87-1.constraint: POS system must store BIN information for use at swipe time

BR-87-2.statement: If Partial Approvals are not supported, transaction is either approved for full amount or declined.
BR-87-2.constraint: Transaction approved for full amount or declined

BR-87-3.statement: A Split Tender transaction results when a Partial Approval is returned to the POS in the transaction response.
BR-87-3.constraint: POS must prompt for payment of remaining balance using another tender type

BR-88-1.statement: Clinical Services (Code 890) is optional and included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-88-1.constraint: Product Code 890 optional; amount rolls into Total QHP Amount

BR-88-2.statement: Dental Services (Code 891) is optional and included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-88-2.constraint: Product Code 891 optional; amount rolls into Total QHP Amount

BR-88-3.statement: Prescription/Rx Only (Code 892) is optional and included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-88-3.constraint: Product Code 892 optional; amount rolls into Total QHP Amount

BR-88-4.statement: Vision/Optical (Code 893) is optional and included in Total QHP Amount.
BR-88-4.constraint: Product Code 893 optional; amount rolls into Total QHP Amount

BR-88-5.statement: Total QHP Amount (Code 894) is required and includes Clinical, Dental, Rx, and Vision amounts.
BR-88-5.constraint: Product Code 894 is required when QHP products present

BR-88-6.statement: Co-Payment (Code 895) is optional, identifying total amount for co-payments.

BR-88-7.statement: Transit (Code 896) is optional, identifying total amount for transit purchases.

BR-89-1.statement: FSA/HRA transaction requests include Market-Specific Data Indicator, Partial Approval Indicator, and Product Code.
BR-89-1.constraint: Must include MSDI, Partial Approval Indicator, and Product Code

BR-89-2.statement: FSA/HRA transaction responses contain no data elements specific to FSA/HRA transactions.

BR-89-3.statement: Partial Approval Indicator and Product Code Data Segment are required in FSA/HRA Purchase/Capture transaction.
BR-89-3.constraint: Partial Approval Indicator and Product Code Data Segment required

BR-90-1.statement: Credit card receipt requirements apply to FSA/HRA card transactions.

BR-90-2.statement: Approved FSA/HRA receipts must print an indicator identifying QHP items.
BR-90-2.constraint: Must include indicator identifying QHP items

BR-90-3.statement: Approved FSA/HRA receipts must print subtotal of QHP amount including taxes and discounts.
BR-90-3.constraint: Must include QHP subtotal with taxes and discounts

BR-91-13.statement: Receipts must include account number, expiration date, transaction date/time, sequence number, product and balance info, approved/declined message, signature line.
BR-91-13.constraint: Receipt must contain these listed data items.

BR-91-2.statement: Transaction Type must print on all receipts.
BR-91-2.constraint: Transaction Type prints on all receipts.

BR-92-1.statement: The Expiration Date must be suppressed on all transaction receipts.

BR-92-10.statement: Fuel and nonfuel product information must appear on receipt for an approved transaction.
BR-92-10.constraint: Fuel type, quantity, price, total amount (fuel); units, unit price, total amount (nonfuel) must print

BR-92-11.statement: Balance information prints on receipt for Partial Approval and Balance Return with Purchase transactions.
BR-92-11.condition: Partial Approval transaction or Balance Return with Purchase transaction
BR-92-11.constraint: Available card balance prints on approved or declined receipt when returned by issuer

BR-92-2.statement: Account Number must be truncated/suppressed to its last four digits on all transaction receipts.
BR-92-2.constraint: Show X's for suppressed digits then last four digits

BR-92-3.statement: A series of X's equal to suppressed digits precedes last four digits, matching original Account Number length.
BR-92-3.constraint: Masked field length equals original Account Number length

BR-92-4.statement: Full Account Number is retrievable from terminal journal or transaction log for retrieval requests.
BR-92-4.constraint: Full Account Number must be retrievable from journal/log

BR-92-5.statement: If manual entry is used, an asterisk (*) precedes the Account Number on receipt and journal.

BR-92-6.statement: Expiration Date must be suppressed on all transaction receipts.

BR-92-7.statement: Transaction date prints on all credit card receipts.
BR-92-7.constraint: Transaction Date must print on receipt

BR-92-8.statement: Transaction time prints on all credit card receipts.
BR-92-8.constraint: Transaction Time must print on receipt

BR-92-9.statement: Sequence Number appears on all credit card receipts.
BR-92-9.constraint: Sequence Number must print on receipt

BR-93-1.statement: Approval phrase including approval code must be on receipt for an approved transaction involving a point-of-sale device.
BR-93-1.condition: Transaction is approved and involves a point-of-sale device
BR-93-1.constraint: Approval phrase and approval code must print on receipt

BR-93-2.statement: Decline message must be on receipt for a declined transaction involving a point-of-sale device using the preprint feature.
BR-93-2.condition: Transaction declined, point-of-sale device uses preprint feature
BR-93-2.constraint: Decline message must print on receipt

BR-93-3.statement: Decline message is displayed on device's screen for a customer-activated device.
BR-93-3.constraint: Decline message shown on screen instead of receipt

BR-93-4.statement: A signature line prints only on the merchant's copy of the credit card transaction receipt.
BR-93-4.condition: Receipt is merchant's copy of credit card transaction
BR-93-4.constraint: Signature line must print only on merchant copy

BR-94-1.statement: These two items must be separated by an "=" sign, rather than a Field Separator.
BR-94-1.constraint: separated by an "=" sign, rather than a Field Separator

BR-94-10.statement: Expiration Date in Card Discretionary Block Data follows Account Number and account delimiter, 4-digit YYMM format.

BR-94-11.statement: TransArmor-Verifone Edition processing is exempt from the no-reuse-of-captured-data rule.
BR-94-11.constraint: Exception to clearing transaction data reuse rule

BR-94-2.statement: Device at point of interaction must not display/store card-read data except account number, expiration date, and cardholder name.
BR-94-2.constraint: Only account number, expiration date, cardholder name may be stored

BR-94-3.statement: Merchant device must not store full magnetic stripe data.
BR-94-3.constraint: Full magnetic stripe data storage prohibited

BR-94-4.statement: Full card-read data, including discretionary data, must not be stored.
BR-94-4.constraint: Prohibition on storing full card-read data

BR-94-5.statement: Card data in authorization or clearing transaction must not result from previously captured full card-read data.
BR-94-5.constraint: No reuse of previously captured full card-read data

BR-94-6.statement: Default track sent to host should be Track 2 if device supports it; otherwise send unaltered Track 1 before manual entry.
BR-94-6.constraint: Send Track 2; else send Track 1 unaltered

BR-94-8.statement: Host message should only contain Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data fields with Account Number and Expiration Date (YYMM).
BR-94-8.constraint: Only Account Number and Expiration Date (YYMM) permitted

BR-94-9.statement: Account Number and Expiration Date must be separated by an '=' sign, not a Field Separator.
BR-94-9.constraint: Use '=' delimiter between Account Number and Expiration Date

BR-95-2.statement: Track 2 data is kept in the In Flight Table while transaction is in process, removed when completed.
BR-95-2.constraint: Track 2 data retained in In Flight Table until completion

BR-95-3.statement: All offline transactions must send full unaltered track data, including both Track 1 and Track 2 formats.
BR-95-3.constraint: Full unaltered Track 1 and Track 2 data must be sent

BR-96-1.statement: Device does not perform expiration date validation on debit cards; on-line authorization required regardless of expiration date.
BR-96-1.condition: Card processed as a debit transaction
BR-96-1.constraint: On-line authorization must be requested regardless of expiration date

BR-96-2.statement: A Debit Card Completion transaction can only be processed one time and cannot be reversed or reprocessed.
BR-96-2.constraint: Cannot be reversed or processed again by the device

BR-96-3.statement: If no response is received for a Debit Card Completion, device should resend on next dial attempt or 30 minutes later, whichever first.
BR-96-3.condition: No response received to Debit Card Completion transaction
BR-96-3.constraint: Resend request on next dial attempt or after 30 minutes, whichever occurs first

BR-96-4.statement: If Response Code = 1 (decline) and Decline Code = 24, treat transaction as already captured and update totals as approved.
BR-96-4.constraint: Treat as already captured on BUYPASS; update device totals as approved

BR-96-5.statement: Any response to a Debit Card Completion transaction, approved or declined, should end retry attempts.
BR-96-5.condition: Any response received to Debit Card Completion transaction
BR-96-5.constraint: End retry attempts whether approved or declined

BR-96-6.statement: PIN entry is required on a DES-compliant device and must be encrypted using the DUKPT PIN encryption method for debit transactions.
BR-96-6.constraint: PIN entry required, encrypted via DUKPT method

BR-96-9.statement: If device cannot read magnetic stripe, prompt user to swipe again up to three times before displaying message and ending transaction.
BR-96-9.condition: Device unable to read card's magnetic strip
BR-96-9.constraint: Retry swipe up to three times, then end transaction with clerk message

BR-97-1.statement: Partial approval information is returned when Partial Approval Indicator value of 1 is sent.
BR-97-1.constraint: Response includes Response Code F, Approved Amount, and card balance

BR-97-2.statement: Response Code value F indicates approval, partial amount approved.

BR-97-3.statement: Approved Amount contains the approved partial amount; POS must prompt for remaining balance due.
BR-97-3.constraint: POS device must prompt for payment of remaining balance

BR-97-4.statement: Card balance, if returned by issuer, is in the Additional Information Data Segment.
BR-97-4.constraint: Card balance appears in Segment No. 112

BR-97-5.statement: Partial Approval transactions are supported for POS Purchase, POS Purchase with Cashback, POS Authorization Only, CAT Authorization Only.
BR-97-5.constraint: Only these transaction types support Partial Approval

BR-97-7.statement: Merchants supporting cashback must also support Partial Approval transactions per Interlink mandate (April 2013).

BR-98-1.statement: If cashback is partially approved, the partially approved amount applies only to the purchase, not cashback.
BR-98-1.constraint: Partially approved amount applies to purchase only, not cashback

BR-98-4.statement: Sequence Number must match the Sequence Number contained in the original transaction request.
BR-98-4.constraint: Sequence Number must equal original transaction request's Sequence Number

BR-99-1.statement: All approved and partially approved authorization transactions must be either cleared or reversed.

BR-99-2.statement: Acquirers must ensure authorization reversals for card-present transactions are processed within 24 hours.
BR-99-2.condition: Card-present transaction cancelled or submitted in error

BR-99-3.statement: Card-absent merchants are allowed up to 72 hours to process required partial or full authorization reversals.

BR-99-5.statement: Authorization Only Reversal supports POS Authorization Only (Transaction Type code '3') and CAT Authorization Only (code '5').

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-13-6.statement: PKI encrypts Track 1, Track 2, and Keyed data.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-15-1.statement: Expiration Date must be included in Card Discretionary Block Data when data entry method is manually keyed.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-15-1.condition: Data Entry Method = Original Transaction Data-Manually keyed
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-15-1.constraint: Expiration Date must be included in Element No. 12

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-16-11.statement: Multi-Pay Tokens can be used for refunds and credits also.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-19-1.statement: When data entry is manually keyed, Expiration Date must be included in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element No. 12).
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-19-1.condition: Data Entry Method = Original Transaction Data - Manually keyed
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-19-1.constraint: Expiration Date must be in Card Discretionary Block Data

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-19-3.statement: EDATA Identifier value 4 indicates Unencrypted Track1/Track2 or PAN data for original transaction data entry methods.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-19-3.condition: Data Entry Method = Original Transaction Data (swiped, RFID, or manually keyed)

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-20-4.statement: Supported card types for both processing methods are Credit, Debit, and EBT (food stamp, cash benefits, eWIC).

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-21-1.statement: Merchandise Return (type 7) can use the Token or the card's account information.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-21-1.constraint: May use Token or card account information

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-23-1.statement: For an initial manually keyed transaction and all follow-on transactions, expiration date must be included in Card Discretionary Block Data.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-23-1.condition: Initial manually keyed transaction or follow-on transaction
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-23-1.constraint: Expiration date must be included in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element No. 12)

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-26-1.statement: For an initial manually keyed transaction and all follow-on transactions, expiration date must be included in Card Discretionary Block Data.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-26-1.condition: Initial manually keyed transaction or follow-on transaction
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-26-1.constraint: Expiration date must be included in Card Discretionary Block Data (Element No. 12)

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-28-3.statement: Registration requires initiating a $1.00 MasterCard Sale transaction and swiping the RegiStart Card.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-28-3.constraint: Must initiate $1.00 MasterCard Sale transaction with RegiStart Card

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-46-4.statement: EDATA Identifier value 1 = Encrypted Track1 data, 2 = Track2 data, 3 = manually-keyed PAN.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-48-3.statement: [EDATA] Identifier value 4 indicates unencrypted data (Track1, Track2, manually-keyed PAN).

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-50-4.statement: Value M indicates TA-VE with multiple terminal numbers and logical lanes, TID derived from BUYPASS ID, Terminal Number, and Lane.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-50-4.constraint: TID comes from BUYPASS ID, Terminal Number, and Lane

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-52-1.statement: For swiped transactions, Expiration Date is included within encrypted track data and must not be altered.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-52-1.constraint: Expiration Date within track data must be encrypted and unaltered

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-52-2.statement: For key-entered transactions, a Field Separator must appear between [EDATA] and Expiration Date.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-52-2.constraint: All keyed transactions and tokens must include Field Separator before Expiration Date

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-52-4.statement: Encrypted Keyed PAN has a maximum length of 400 bytes.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-52-6.statement: Expiration Date is sent to BUYPASS only when the Initial Transaction is a keyed transaction.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-55-3.statement: All keyed and token transactions must include a Field Separator between EDATA and Expiration Date.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-55-3.constraint: Field Separator present between EDATA and Expiration Date

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-55-5.statement: Expiration Date is sent to BUYPASS only when the Initial Transaction is a keyed transaction.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-5.statement: For Track 2 card reads, Account Number is data before '=' and Card Discretionary Block Data is data after '='.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-5.condition: Account Number obtained from Track 2 card reader
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-5.constraint: Split at '=' character instead of Field Separator

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-6.statement: For Track 1 card reads (credit only), Account Number is data before first '^' and Card Discretionary Block Data is data after it.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-6.condition: Account Number obtained from Track 1 card reader (credit cards only)
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-6.constraint: Split at first '^' character instead of Field Separator

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-9.statement: Track data placed in combined Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data fields cannot exceed total length of those elements.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-57-9.constraint: Track data length must not exceed combined element length

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-58-3.statement: Stored Value cards Account Number length should be 16 or 19 bytes.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-58-4.statement: For First Data Premium Gift Card Transaction Response, calculated card number returned in Account Number field.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-58-4.condition: First Data Premium Gift Card Transaction Response
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-58-4.constraint: Calculated card number is returned in Account Number field

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-58-7.statement: Certegy service requires driver's license data in positions 1-24 of Account Number.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-58-9.statement: Loyalty Totals Request with Update Code 'T' requires words 'TOTALS REQUEST' in Account Number.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-58-9.condition: Loyalty card, Update Code = T (Totals Request)

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-59-4.statement: When manually keyed, both Account Number and Sub-Account Number presentation are required for Processing.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-59-4.constraint: Both Account Number and Sub-Account Number must be present

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-59-6.statement: In any other loyalty advice transaction, the field value is the actual Loyalty Account Number.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-2.statement: For Track 2, Account Number is data before '=' and Card Discretionary Block Data is data after '='.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-2.condition: Account Number obtained from Track 2 card reader
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-2.constraint: Use '=' as separator between Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-3.statement: For Track 1 credit cards, Account Number is data before first '^' and remainder is Card Discretionary Block Data.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-3.condition: Account Number obtained from Track 1 card reader (credit cards only)
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-3.constraint: Use '^' as separator between Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-4.statement: Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data combined do not exceed 76 characters for Track 1.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-60-5.statement: Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data combined do not exceed 37 characters for Track 2.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-61-3.statement: Certegy transaction requires 2-character State Code and 6-character birth date (MMDDYY).
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-61-3.constraint: Provide 2-char State Code and MMDDYY birth date

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-62-3.statement: TransArmor Token Only transaction may be declined if BUYPASS cannot retrieve the necessary token for the PAN.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-62-3.condition: TransArmor Token Only transaction, token retrieval fails
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-62-3.constraint: Transaction is declined; see Appendix for details

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-64-2.statement: All Financial Transaction Request, Totals Request, Loyalty Card Request, and Electronic Mail Request messages contain Message Format Version Identifier in Field No. 1.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-65-3.statement: For Loyalty Card Request messages, Element No. 63 and Data Segment No. 108 always follow this data element.
