BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-65-3.constraint: Number of Segments then Loyalty Card Data Segment always follow

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-66-3.statement: Loyalty Card Transaction Requests: Element 63 followed by Data Section No. 2 (Speedpass Segment 100) and Data Section No. 3 with Segments 108 and 114.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-66-4.statement: ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Requests: Element 63 followed by Data Section No. 2 (Segment 100) and Data Section No. 3 with Segments 110 and 111.

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-70-1.statement: For financial transactions, Response Code identifies approval with purchase/capture, approval without purchase/capture, or decline.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-70-1.constraint: Response Code indicates approval w/ capture, approval w/o capture, or decline

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-2.statement: In a preauthorized transaction, Sequence Number in Purchase/Capture equals the Sequence Number in the Authorization Only request.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-2.constraint: Sequence Number = original Authorization Only Sequence Number

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-5.statement: Authorization Only Reversal applies to POS Authorization Only (3), POS Mail/Phone Authorization Only (B), and CAT Authorization Only (5).
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-76-5.constraint: Applies only to Transaction Type codes 3, B, 5

BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-78-1.statement: The Terminal Identifier must be assigned by and set up at BUYPASS.
BR-ATL105-TRANSARMOR-78-1.constraint: assigned by and set up at BUYPASS

BR-BUYPASS-IIN-4-1.statement: This document discusses IIN information for card types including Amex, Debit, Diners Club, Discover, EBT, Fleet One, Fleetwide, Fuelman, JCB, MasterCard, MasterCard Fleet, Visa, Visa Fleet, Voyager, WEX.

BR-BUYPASS-IIN-9-5.statement: Visa, MasterCard, and Discover will implement the change from six-digit to eight-digit issuing BINs to align with ISO standard.
BR-BUYPASS-IIN-9-5.constraint: Issuing BIN length changes from 6 to 8 digits

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-11-1.statement: Adjustment to Price is not provided on a 310 message because it is a preauthorization.

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-4-4.statement: Transaction Type value 200 means Limited Spend Refund.

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-2.statement: The PI dataset is required when evaluation of the market basket must be completed by IH to authorize a discount, payment, or refund.
BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-2.condition: Evaluation of the market basket must be completed by IH to authorize a discount, payment, or refund

BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-3.statement: PI dataset required when evaluation of market basket must be completed by IH to authorize a discount, payment, or refund.
BR-BUYPASS-INCOMM-MBD-6-3.condition: IH must evaluate market basket for discount/payment/refund

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-11-4.statement: BUYPASS begins transmission of ENQ characters as soon as a modem connection is established.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-12-4.statement: If connecting via third-party network provider, BUYPASS ENQ's are absorbed and provider sends its own ENQ stream.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-12-4.constraint: BUYPASS has no control over ENQ number/interval

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-13-1.statement: BUYPASS continues to transmit ENQ at regular intervals until a packet is received.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-13-1.condition: No initial message received from customer device

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-14-1.statement: If no initial message is received after a certain period, BUYPASS sends an EOT character and disconnects.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-14-1.condition: No initial message received within timeout period

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-15-3.statement: Both single-threaded and multithreaded protocols are initiated by an ENQ character (0x05) from BUYPASS.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-18-1.statement: All transactions are declined if the controller bit is set for a merchant not configured as a controller.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-18-1.condition: Controller bit set and merchant not configured as controller in BUYPASS database

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-18-2.statement: If Controller bit is set, BUYPASS maintains the link briefly after last outstanding transaction response is processed.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-18-2.constraint: Link maintained for short period after last transaction response

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-20-2.statement: End-of-Session packet ID is always 0x9c; BUYPASS disconnects in one second.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-22-3.statement: For transactions, the message area contains messages per BUYPASS Platform Asynchronous Message Format Specifications without STX, ETX, or LRC characters.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-22-4.statement: BUYPASS Platform message format request messages consist of variable-length data elements separated by FS (0x1c) characters.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-22-4.constraint: Data elements separated by FS (0x1c) characters

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-22-5.statement: BUYPASS Platform message format response messages are generally fixed format messages.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-22-6.statement: For transactions, the message area contains messages per BUYPASS Platform ATL102 Message Format Specifications without STX, ETX, or LRC characters.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-22-7.statement: For transactions, the message area contains messages as described in BUYPASS Platform Host and Controller Interface Specifications.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-22-9.statement: The information packet contains one or more message areas, which may have several formats including Asynchronous, Host-to-Controller, NCR NDP, BUYPASS Platform, Communications performance data, or other transaction formats.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-33-3.statement: BUYPASS sends an end-of-session packet prior to disconnecting.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-37-3.statement: BUYPASS starts an idle timer after receiving ACK for last outstanding transaction from customer device or last load packet.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-37-3.condition: Packet header request flags indicate customer device or last packet header response flag set for a load
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-37-3.constraint: Start idle timer after ACK for last outstanding transaction

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-37-4.statement: If no additional valid requests received during idle period, BUYPASS sends end-of-session packet and disconnects.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-37-4.condition: Idle timer expires with no additional valid requests

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-38-1.statement: If device is stand-alone POS and last packet header response flag not set for load, BUYPASS sends end-of-session and disconnects after ACK received.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-38-1.condition: Stand-alone POS device and last packet header response flag not set for a load
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-38-1.constraint: BUYPASS sends end-of-session packet and disconnects immediately after ACK received

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-43-1.statement: All dial devices are required to support BUYPASS download transactions for loading phone numbers and encryption information.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-43-1.constraint: Dial devices must support BUYPASS download transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-43-2.statement: BUYPASS Terminal Identifier is included in every request including financial, utility, and download requests.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-43-2.constraint: Terminal Identifier must appear in every request message.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-44-1.statement: Terminal software should not be activated until at least one successful Table Load has been performed.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-44-1.constraint: All BUYPASS transactions except downline loads prohibited

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-45-1.statement: Dial device communicating with BUYPASS must support downloading phone numbers, and PIN encryption key if Master Session encryption used.
BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-45-1.constraint: Must support download of PIN encryption key

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-8-1.statement: BUYPASS currently supports modem speeds of 300, 1,200, and 2,400 bps.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-8-2.statement: All new devices on BUYPASS must support 1,200 bps or more.

BR-BUYPASS-MTAP-9-1.statement: BUYPASS neither supports nor allows predialing.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-1.statement: When several applications are mutually supported, terminal must request cardholder selection or auto-select highest priority application.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-1.constraint: Request cardholder selection (if capable) or auto-select highest priority application

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-2.statement: DF30 Fuel Card usage bitmap: each prompt is 3 bytes; industry allows up to 8 prompts; WEX uses no more than 6 bytes, padding remainder with zeroes.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-2.constraint: Max 6 bytes used by WEX, remaining padded with zeroes

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-3.statement: DF36 Relationship Codes tag is not required; used for WEX Private Label Program.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-4.statement: DF37 3rd Party Reference Data Generation 2 tag is not required; used for WEX Private Label Program.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-5.statement: DF38 Loyalty ID tag is not required; used for WEX Private Label Program.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-6.statement: DF32 Offline Purchase Restrictions supports store and forward with chip authorization; see section 10.2.3.5.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-7.statement: DF34 and DF35 WEX tags support store and forward with chip authorization for fuel and non-fuel purchase restriction amounts respectively.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-100-7.constraint: Use DF34 for fuel, DF35 for non-fuel restriction amounts

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-1.statement: Terminal must extract WEX tag DF30 (Fuel Card usage bitmap) from application selection response when present.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-1.condition: Tag DF30 is present in application selection response
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-1.constraint: Terminal must extract the data element

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-2.statement: After application selection response analysis, terminal may process EMV Processing Part 1 and Prompting functions in parallel.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-2.constraint: Process both functions in parallel if possible

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-3.statement: When parallel processing is not possible, terminal must first process EMV Processing (Part 1) function.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-3.constraint: EMV Processing Part 1 must be processed first

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-4.statement: Transaction amount in Tag 9F02 is required to be accurate for a purchase transaction.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-5.statement: Transaction amount in Tag 9F02 is preferred to be an estimated amount for a pre-authorization transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-5.constraint: Amount preferred to be estimated (fixed holding amount alternative only with WEX card)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-6.statement: Prompt Code in Data Element field of Byte 1 and Prompt Part 2 of Byte 3 are fixed values.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-6.constraint: Byte 1 Data Element and Byte 3 Prompt Part 2 are fixed

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-7.statement: If a terminal cannot request a specific prompt, the prompt is skipped and no unentered value should be sent.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-7.condition: Terminal cannot support a specific prompt
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-7.constraint: Skip prompt; do not send unentered value

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-101-8.statement: Terminals that cannot support alphabetic or special characters will be certified by WEX with numeric-only response.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-1.statement: On offline approval or decline, terminal must stop driver prompting, request card removal, inform driver, and process Transaction Completion.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-1.constraint: Stop prompting, request card removal, inform driver, process Transaction Completion

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-2.statement: If Faster EMV Solution active, terminal must complete transaction with card before processing other Start ICC response info.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-2.constraint: Complete transaction with card prior to processing other response info

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-3.statement: Terminal must inform card online authorization failed due to communication problem and decline with EMV Authorization Response Code Z3.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-3.constraint: EMV Authorization Response Code = Z3 - Unable to Go Online, offline declined

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-4.statement: API response must be ignored after sending decline completion request.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-4.condition: After Complete ICC transaction Device Request sent with Z3

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-5.statement: Prompt driver for Tag DF30 Fuel Card usage bitmap info if not already prompted during application selection response analysis.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-5.condition: Not already prompted during application selection response analysis
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-5.constraint: Prompt driver for Tag DF30 data

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-6.statement: If Tag DF31 (complementary bitmap) is not empty (not all bytes '00'), prompt driver for that information.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-6.condition: Tag DF31 not empty (not all bytes 00)
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:DF31 Fuel Card usage bitmap (Complementary values)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-102-7.statement: If terminal supports Tags DF37, DF38, DF36, run additional function linked to their presence.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-1.statement: If chip card not present and terminal in Faster EMV mode, apply WEX Authorization Host decision.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-1.condition: Chip card not present, Faster EMV mode

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-10.statement: Preauthorization approved by VRU: terminal must not allow transaction to exceed amount authorized; completion sent when communication restored.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-10.constraint: Do not exceed authorized amount; send completion later

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-11.statement: Preauthorization approved by Chip: terminal must follow offline purchase restriction limits; completion sent when communication restored.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-11.constraint: Follow offline purchase restrictions; send completion later

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-12.statement: Sales transaction approved by WEX: POS terminal will complete its local processing.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-2.statement: If chip card not present and terminal not in Faster EMV mode, the transaction is aborted.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-2.condition: Chip card not present, not Faster EMV mode

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-3.statement: If chip card present and response received, terminal must apply WEX Chip Application decision, which may confirm WEX Authorization Host decision.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-3.condition: Chip card present and response received

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-4.statement: When DE 55 is present in online response and Issuer Authentication Data (tag '91') is part of chip data, terminal must extract 8 least bytes of Issuer Authentication Data.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-4.condition: DE 55 present and Issuer Authentication Data tag '91' present
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-4.constraint: Terminal must extract 8 least significant bytes of Issuer Authentication Data

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-5.statement: Terminal must ignore values of Proprietary Authentication Data; no usage is currently defined.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-6.statement: If no response from WEX and chip still present, terminal may approve transaction offline using chip values.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-6.constraint: Terminal may approve offline; reason code must reflect chip usage

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-7.statement: If no response from WEX, merchant may call for authorization via VRU; reason code must reflect VRU usage.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-7.constraint: Merchant calls VRU; reason code reflects VRU authorization

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-8.statement: Declined transaction: a receipt may be printed.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-103-9.statement: Preauthorization approved by WEX: POS terminal must follow all limits returned.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-1.statement: POS terminal must store and forward transaction via VRU once communication restored.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-2.statement: POS terminal must follow offline purchase restriction limits for chip and store/forward once communication restored.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-2.constraint: Follow section 10.2.3.5 limits, then store and forward

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-3.statement: If card removed before 'card removal request', transaction must be aborted and Driver informed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-3.condition: Card removed before card removal request

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-4.statement: If authorization response already received, terminal must send reversal message to WEX Authorization Host.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-4.condition: Card removed early after authorization response received

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-5.statement: Terminal may print a receipt after aborted transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-5.condition: Transaction aborted due to early card removal

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-6.statement: Terminal should store info on declined transactions for troubleshooting.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-7.statement: Terminal should support maintenance function to print/display stored troubleshooting information.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-8.statement: Terminal should be able to print/display current TAC, Terminal Capabilities, and Additional Terminal Capabilities parameters.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-9.statement: Before 1st GENERATE AC command, card may simply be powered off if transaction cancelled.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-104-9.condition: Transaction cancelled before 1st GENERATE AC command

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-105-1.statement: Between 1st and 2nd GENERATE AC, terminal should request 'Unable to go online - ACC' and send a void to WEX.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-105-1.condition: Between 1st GENERATE AC and 2nd GENERATE AC command
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-105-1.constraint: Request Unable to go online - ACC; void sent to WEX

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-105-2.statement: If transaction was approved, it should be voided by the POS terminal.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-105-2.constraint: POS terminal must void the transaction

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-106-1.statement: If magnetic stripe read and Technology Indicator is 0, terminal processes as magnetic stripe.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-106-2.statement: If magnetic stripe read and Technology Indicator is 2, terminal requires card to be dipped/inserted for chip read.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-106-2.constraint: Terminal requires card dip/insert to read chip

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-107-1.statement: WEX has no specific requirements for EMV terminal parameters common to all applications; values follow Payment Industry standard.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-107-2.statement: Terminal Type (9F35) must be online capable, either online-only or offline with online capability, per WEX.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-107-3.statement: Terminal Capabilities (9F33) must comply with values defined by WEX; see Appendix F.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-107-3.constraint: Must comply with WEX-defined values in Appendix F

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-108-1.statement: Default DDOL used for INTERNAL AUTHENTICATE if DDOL not present in card: 9F3704
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Default Dynamic Data Authentication Data Object List (DDOL)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-108-2.statement: Default TDOL used for generating TC Hash Value if TDOL not present in card: not required
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Default Transaction Certificate Data Object List (TDOL)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-108-3.statement: Application Version Number value must be 0001

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-108-4.statement: Application Selection Indicator indicates whether AID must match exactly or only partially; partial match is supported

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-109-1.statement: There are no WEX-defined EMV terminal parameters with values dedicated to each WEX application.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-109-1.constraint: All EMV terminal parameter values apply to all WEX AID.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-1.statement: CDA must be implemented according to EMV 4.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-10.statement: An offline capable terminal must support both DDA and CDA; SDA is optional.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-10.constraint: Must support DDA and CDA, SDA optional

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-11.statement: An online-only terminal may support no offline CAM.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-12.statement: When CDA is supported, it must be implemented per EMV 4.2 or later using CDA Mode n°1 from EMV 4.3 Book 2.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-12.constraint: Must request CDA on 1st and 2nd GENERATE AC as specified

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-13.statement: When CDA supported, terminal should verify Certification Authority Public Key presence before Terminal Action Analysis.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-13.constraint: Verify CA Public Key before Terminal Action Analysis

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-14.statement: When offline CAM supported, terminal must support at least two WEX Certification Authority Public Keys for the WEX RID.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-14.constraint: Support minimum 2 WEX CA Public Keys per RID

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-15.statement: When offline CAM supported, terminal must support RSA key length of 248 bytes and exponent 3 or (2^16+1).
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-15.constraint: RSA key length 248 bytes, exponent 3 or 2^16+1

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-16.statement: The terminal must be capable to check the integrity of the Certification Authority Public Keys.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-2.statement: CDA is supported — CDA must be implemented according to EMV 4.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-2.constraint: CDA must be implemented according to EMV 4

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-3.statement: Unattended terminals must support 'No CVM Required'.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-4.statement: Unattended terminals must not support signature as CVM.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-5.statement: Online enciphered PIN support is optional at unattended terminals.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-6.statement: Offline PIN support is optional at unattended terminals.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-7.statement: Attended terminals must support signature as CVM.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-8.statement: Support of 'No CVM Required' is optional at attended terminals.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-110-9.statement: Online enciphered PIN and offline PIN are optional at attended terminals.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-1.statement: WEX's preference is for WEX Chip as the purchase device.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-1.constraint: Prefer WEX Chip over magnetic stripe or manual entry

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-2.statement: Magnetic stripe fallback must indicate 'Fallback to Magnetic Stripe'.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-2.condition: Terminal is chip capable and certified for WEX Chip but chip read fails
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-2.constraint: Magnetic stripe swipe must indicate 'Fallback to Magnetic Stripe'

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-3.statement: Unattended terminals, when chip capable and certified, must direct to 'See Attendant' before falling back to magnetic stripe.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-3.condition: Terminal Capability = Chip capable, certified; Unattended Terminal
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-3.constraint: Priority order: WEX Chip, 'See Attendant', Magnetic Stripe (if no attendant)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-4.statement: Tag 'DF30' holds the prompts to be requested of the Driver.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-4.constraint: Prompts specified in Byte 1 Bit 8-4 and Byte 3 Bit 6-5 of DF30

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-111-5.statement: Each entry in DF30 is one prompt, with additional info to reduce hard-coding at POS.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-1.statement: If a prompt is Mandatory and the device cannot capture it, the transaction is declined by the device.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-1.condition: Prompt requirement = Mandatory and device unable to capture prompt
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-1.constraint: Transaction is declined by the device

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-2.statement: If prompt is printed on receipt, the prompt value entered by the driver is masked.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-2.constraint: Prompt value entered by driver is masked on receipt

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-3.statement: If prompt display on entry is clear, the prompt is displayed as entered; if masked, displayed as characters.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-3.condition: Prompt display on entry = Display clear (1) or Display masked (0)
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-3.constraint: Display shows actual value or masked characters accordingly

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-112-4.statement: Additional Data Source (Byte 2) and Use of Additional Data Source (Byte 1) are not used by WEX.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-1.statement: WEX's preference is for online authorization; purchase restrictions on stripe/chip used only if offline.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-1.constraint: POS uses purchase restrictions from magnetic stripe or chip

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-2.statement: WEX Chip transactions must include AID, Application Preferred Name/Label, and GENERATE AC cryptogram on approved fleet card receipts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-2.constraint: Receipt must include AID, application name/label, and cryptogram

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-3.statement: Sequence Number field printed on receipt for WEX transactions represents the WEX Invoice Number.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-3.constraint: Sequence Number = WEX Invoice Number on receipt

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-4.statement: If connectivity is lost during a Chip transaction, POS may use Chip Limits for purchase amount or call for authorization.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-4.condition: Connectivity lost while processing Chip transaction
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-4.constraint: Use Chip Limits or call for authorization

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-5.statement: POS limits fuel purchase to fuel amount and non-fuel purchase to non-fuel amount per chip limits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-5.constraint: Fuel and non-fuel purchases must not exceed respective chip-defined amounts

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-6.statement: If POS does not process fuel/non-fuel amount limits, transaction should call for authorization and be limited to fuel products only.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-6.condition: POS does not process fuel/non-fuel amount validations
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-6.constraint: Call for authorization; limit purchase to fuel products only

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-7.statement: Standard EMV terminal uses Tag DF32 for Offline Purchase Restrictions and Tag DF34 for Offline Purchase Restrictions Amount for Fuel.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-113-7.constraint: Use Tag DF32 and DF34 for offline restrictions

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-1.statement: Offline purchase limits usable at attended or unattended terminal for preauthorization or sales transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-1.constraint: Limits apply to either attended or unattended terminal transactions.
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Tag 'DF35' : Offline Purchase Restrictions Amount for non-Fuel purchase

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-2.statement: If terminal does not support chip authorization or limits are exceeded, terminal may call for authorization.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-2.condition: Terminal lacks chip authorization support or limits exceeded
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Tag 'DF35' : Offline Purchase Restrictions Amount for non-Fuel purchase

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-3.statement: For preauthorization, fuel limit acts like partial authorization or pump shut-off amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-3.constraint: Cardholder fuels up to specified amount; non-fuel purchases limited to non-fuel amount.
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Tag 'DF35' : Offline Purchase Restrictions Amount for non-Fuel purchase

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-4.statement: For sales transaction, fuel and non-fuel purchase amounts should not exceed chip-specified amounts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-4.constraint: Fuel/non-fuel amount purchased must not exceed chip-specified limits.
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Tag 'DF35' : Offline Purchase Restrictions Amount for non-Fuel purchase

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-5.statement: If fuel or non-fuel amount exceeds chip limit, cashier may be directed to call for authorization.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-5.condition: Fuel or non-fuel amount exceeds chip-specified limit
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-114-5.constraint: Cashier directed to call for authorization to obtain approval code.
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Tag 'DF35' : Offline Purchase Restrictions Amount for non-Fuel purchase

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-1.statement: Terminal is expected to perform a MOD-10 check on the 6 digit Account Number in WEX Account Number field.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-1.constraint: Perform MOD-10 check on 6-digit Account Number

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-2.statement: Terminal is expected to perform expiration date validation.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-3.statement: Field Separator value is '=' in magnetic stripe or 'D' in Track 2 equivalent on chip.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-3.condition: Magnetic stripe vs chip Track 2 equivalent

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-4.statement: Prompt Table Key value is not used on a chip transaction; Tag DF30 replaces Prompt Table Key and POS Prompts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-4.constraint: Use Tag DF30 instead of Prompt Table Key

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-5.statement: Purchase Restriction value 00 means Fuel Only, 01 means Unrestricted.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-6.statement: Purchase Restriction is reserved for offline processing mode only.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-7.statement: Purchase Restriction value is not used on a chip transaction; Tag DF32 replaces the use of Purchase Restriction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-115-7.constraint: Use Tag DF32 instead of Purchase Restriction

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-1.statement: Purchase Device Sequence Number is not used on a chip transaction; Tag DF39 replaces it.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-1.constraint: Use Tag DF39 instead of Purchase Device Sequence Number

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-2.statement: POS Prompts value is not used on a chip transaction; Tag DF30 replaces Prompt Table Key and POS Prompts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-2.constraint: Use Tag DF30 instead of Prompt Table Key and POS Prompts

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-3.statement: Terminal must check Technology Indicator to prefer chip usage over magnetic stripe when POS supports WEX Chip.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-3.condition: POS developed to support WEX Chip
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-3.constraint: Prefer chip usage over magnetic stripe based on Technology Indicator

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-4.statement: WEX permits fallback to magstripe if chip cannot be read; no specific fallback requirements defined.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-4.constraint: Fallback to magnetic stripe permitted per industry best practices

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-5.statement: Technology Indicator is NOT aligned with service code used for other card types.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-116-5.constraint: Technology Indicator differs semantically from standard service code

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-117-1.statement: POS shall apply a Purchase Restriction edit against field 7 value in offline processing mode only.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-117-1.constraint: Apply Purchase Restriction edit to field 7 value

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-117-2.statement: Mod 10 Check Digit Calculation is applied to the 6-digit Account Number.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-117-2.constraint: Apply Mod 10 Check Digit Calculation to 6-digit Account Number

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-119-1.statement: Purchase Restriction identifies types of products that can be purchased with card; used only in offline processing mode.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-119-1.constraint: Purchase Restriction field applies only in offline mode

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-120-1.statement: Prompt Code value 10 on WEX card means Odometer, Driver ID.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-120-1.constraint: Means Odometer, Driver ID per Appendix D

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-120-2.statement: Prefix No. for WEX Universal Fleet Card is fixed value 690046 or 707138, identifying card as WEX.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-120-3.statement: Good Thru card expiration date format is MM/YY.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-121-1.statement: Purchase Restriction is used only in offline processing mode for WEX Universal Fleet Card.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-122-1.statement: Prefix No. is an ISO Number with a fixed value of 690046 or 707138, identifying the card as a WEX card.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-122-2.statement: Example Prompt Code value 10 means 'Odometer, Driver ID' per Appendix D WEX-Specific POS Prompt Codes.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-122-3.statement: Good Thru field format is MM/YY representing card expiration date.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-124-1.statement: GSA account number is 18 digits; last 5 digits are the Vehicle Card No.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-124-1.condition: WEX GSA Fleet Card using a Vehicle No.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-124-1.constraint: Account No. is 18 digits with last 5 digits as Vehicle Card No.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-124-2.statement: Prefix No. is a fixed ISO value of 690046 or 707138 identifying card as WEX card.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-125-1.statement: Store and Forward is not supported by COMDATA card processing.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-125-2.statement: Merchant Profile at BUYPASS must have Terminal Special Code 003 enabled to receive COMDATA fleet card transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-125-2.constraint: Terminal Special Code 003 must be enabled

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-125-4.statement: If application does not process a Table Load, it must provide another method to determine if COMDATA fleet cards are allowed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-125-4.condition: application does not process Table Load
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-125-4.constraint: must provide alternate method to allow COMDATA cards

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-1.statement: Account Verification requires Unit Number prompt.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-2.statement: Authorization Only requires Unit Number; other prompts (Driver Number, Trailer Number, Hub Reading, etc.) are conditional.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-2.constraint: Unit Number Required; others Conditional on Account Verification response

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-3.statement: Capture requires Unit Number and Invoice Number; other prompts are conditional.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-3.constraint: Unit Number and Invoice Number Required; others Conditional

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-4.statement: A Conditional prompt should be offered if the Account Verification response indicates that prompt is required.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-4.condition: Account Verification response indicates prompt required

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-5.statement: POS must prompt for data specified, validate formatting, and include prompt responses on subsequent Authorization Only requests.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-126-5.constraint: POS must prompt, validate, and include prompt responses as appropriate

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-1.statement: Invoice number is communicated via prompt code mechanism but is not a customer prompt.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-1.constraint: Invoice number must be unique per location per business day, generated by POS.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-10.statement: Non-Fuel Product limit is sent to terminal as product code '000'.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-11.statement: COMDATA may decline a transaction with a Non-fuel product whose amount exceeds its category limit.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-11.condition: Non-fuel product amount exceeds category limit

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-12.statement: Offline processing is not supported for COMDATA fleet transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-13.statement: If approved maximum dollar amount exceeds AFP pump limit, pump limit may take precedence.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-14.statement: If approved maximum dollar amount is less than AFP pump limit, approved amount takes precedence.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-15.statement: POS device is responsible for enforcing amount limits on fuel products from authorization response.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-15.constraint: POS must enforce fuel product limits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-2.statement: Device must provide Invoice number and all captured prompt responses with Capture message when pumping is complete.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-2.constraint: Send Invoice number plus captured prompts with Capture request

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-3.statement: Prompts where no data has been captured should not be sent to BUYPASS.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-5.statement: Track 1 data will not be accepted.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-6.statement: Track 2 data should be present on card and submitted on swiped or chip read transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-6.constraint: Track 2 data must be submitted as account data

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-7.statement: Terminal must send list of available fuel products in Authorization Only request; Comdata returns limits for each.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-7.constraint: Terminal sends available fuel product list; Comdata responds with limits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-8.statement: Fuel products not listed in the Authorization response will be considered off limit by the terminal.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-8.condition: Product not listed in Authorization response

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-127-9.statement: Cash Available limit is sent to terminal as product code '955'.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-1.statement: All Comdata Card Numbers must be masked on all receipts, failed or successful.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-1.constraint: masked on all receipts, failed or successful

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-10.statement: All Comdata Data Capture items entered must be printed on all receipts except Driver ID and Driver's License/State.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-10.constraint: Print all captured data except Driver ID and Driver's License/State

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-11.statement: Company Name, City, and State from the Comdata response may be printed on all receipts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-11.constraint: Optional printing of Company Name, City, State from response

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-2.statement: COMDATA Fleet authorization requests must send all dispensable fuel products with unit price, quantity 1, total amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-2.constraint: Send all fuel products with unit price, quantity=1, total amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-3.statement: COMDATA Fleet capture request must send actual amounts, product codes, unit price, quantity for fuel and non-fuel products.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-3.constraint: Send actual amounts, product codes, unit price, quantity, actual amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-4.statement: Terminal must send UUID from an original transaction on any subsequent related transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-4.constraint: Subsequent transactions must send the UUID received originally

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-5.statement: AFP devices should always send Completions, and not Purchases.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-5.constraint: Use Completion transaction type instead of Purchase

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-6.statement: Comdata Invoice# must be printed on all receipts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-6.constraint: Invoice Number from SP1 or SP11 request must appear on receipt

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-7.statement: Payment Method Reference must be printed on all receipts, e.g. COMDATA or COMDATA MASTERCARD.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-7.constraint: Print payment method reference text based on card BIN

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-8.statement: All Comdata Card Numbers must be masked on all receipts, failed or successful, except ISO/BIN and last four digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-8.constraint: Mask card number except first six and last four digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-9.statement: Comdata Card Swipe/Chip/Manual indicator may be printed on all receipts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-128-9.constraint: Optional printing of entry method indicator

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-1.statement: present in the response — it must be printed on the receipt.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-1.constraint: it must be printed on the receipt

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-2.statement: POS/OPT transaction indicator may be printed on all receipts; 'Cashier: OPT' means initiated outside.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-3.statement: 6-digit Comdata CTL# (from Approval Code) must be printed on all receipts.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-4.statement: Approval Code on a Completion will differ from Approval Code on its Pre-Auth.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-4.constraint: Approval Code differs from Pre-Auth Approval Code

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-5.statement: Customer ID from completion response should never be printed on any receipt or displayed on screen.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-5.constraint: Do not print or display Customer ID

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-6.statement: Driver Message is optional and only supported on Purchase and Completion responses; must be printed if present.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-129-6.condition: Driver Message present in Purchase or Completion response

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-13-1.statement: Sections 10, 10.2, 10.3, and Appendices I, J, K, L will be updated for Voyager Chip processing requirements.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-13-2.statement: Chapter 3 discusses transaction requirements for POS and CAT Authorization Only, Purchase/Capture, Return/Refund, Reversal/Void, and Time-out Reversal.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-13-3.statement: Chapters 5-9 discuss processing requirements, card layout, and embossing standards for Fleet One, Fuelman/Fleetwide, MasterCard, Visa, and Voyager fleet cards.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-130-3.statement: Merchant Profile must have Terminal Special Code 003 enabled to process Express Code transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-130-3.constraint: Terminal Special Code 003 must be enabled

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-130-6.statement: Express Check Number is required for Card Type 095 (Express Code).

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-1.statement: All Express Code must be masked on all receipts, failed or successful.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-1.constraint: masked on all receipts, failed or successful

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-10.statement: Express Code must be masked on all receipts; only ISO/BIN first six and last four digits unmasked.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-10.condition: Express Code transaction receipt, failed or successful
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-10.constraint: Mask Express Code except first six and last four digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-11.statement: Unit Number and Trip Number, if captured, must be printed on receipts; Driver Number must not be printed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-11.condition: Unit Number or Trip Number captured
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-11.constraint: Print Unit/Trip Number; never print Driver Number

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-12.statement: The 4-digit Auth # must be printed on all receipts.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-2.statement: Prompts where no data has been captured should not be sent to BUYPASS.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-2.constraint: Do not send that prompt's data to BUYPASS

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-3.statement: All Express Code transactions are entered manually.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-4.statement: No product data is to be sent on Express Code transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-4.constraint: Product data must not be sent

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-5.statement: Express Code transaction is approved for full amount or declined; no partial authorization.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-5.constraint: Full approval or decline only, no partial approval

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-6.statement: No product data is expected on Express Code transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-7.statement: Support for UUID is optional on Express Code transactions; no valid follow-on transactions exist.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-7.constraint: UUID optional; follow-on transactions not valid

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-8.statement: The Express Code should be sent in the Account Number field.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-8.constraint: Express Code value placed in Account Number field

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-9.statement: Payment Method Reference 'EXPRESS CODE' must be printed on all receipts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-131-9.constraint: Print 'EXPRESS CODE' as payment method reference

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-132-1.statement: The 6-digit Comdata CTL# must be printed on all receipts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-132-1.constraint: 6-digit Comdata CTL# must be printed on all receipts

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-1.statement: Fuel Price Updates apply only to the Primary Diesel product on commercial pumps, typically Diesel #2.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-1.constraint: Only Primary Diesel product supported for Fuel Price Updates

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-2.statement: If connectivity to BUYPASS is down, terminal must store Fuel Price Update and resend per Store and Forward rules.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-2.condition: Connectivity down or no response received
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-2.constraint: Terminal stores and resends transaction per Store and Forward rules

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-3.statement: During an extended outage, only the most recent Fuel Price Update should be retried once connectivity is restored.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-3.condition: Multiple Fuel Price Updates failed to send during extended outage

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-4.statement: Comdata may decline a transaction if the price per gallon differs by more than $1 from the most recent Fuel Price Update.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-4.condition: Price per gallon differs by more than $1 from last Fuel Price Update

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-5.statement: Merchant Profile at BUYPASS must have Terminal Special Code 003 enabled to receive COMDATA fleet card transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-5.condition: To receive COMDATA fleet card transactions
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-5.constraint: Terminal Special Code 003 must be enabled

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-135-8.statement: UUID is not supported for Fuel Price Update transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-136-3.statement: CASS and CRSS values are formatted as price per gallon with max length 5, e.g. 99.99.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-1.statement: Merchant Profile at BUYPASS must have Terminal Special Code 179 enabled to receive WEX OTR fleet card transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-1.condition: WEX OTR fleet card transactions are to be accepted
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-1.constraint: Terminal Special Code 179 must be enabled

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-2.statement: If terminal accepts only NGFC cards, it should be configured with Terminal Special Code 180 instead.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-2.constraint: Configure Terminal Special Code 180 instead of 179

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-4.statement: If application does not process a Table Load, it must provide another method to determine if WEX OTR fleet cards are allowed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-4.condition: Application does not process a Table Load from BUYPASS
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-4.constraint: Application must provide alternative method to determine WEX OTR fleet card acceptance

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-5.statement: When connection is lost, device stores transactions and forwards them as captures without prior authorization when connection restored.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-5.condition: Device loses connection to BUYPASS or BUYPASS loses connection to WEX OTR Card authorizer
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-137-5.constraint: Transactions forwarded as captures without prior authorization

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-1.statement: Manual entry is not allowed for any WEX OTR card.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-2.statement: If decline code DX, POS must request prompts indicated in response and resend; may repeat up to 3 times.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-2.constraint: Re-request and resubmit prompts up to 3 times, then decline if still unsatisfied

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-3.statement: Each retry iteration must include all available prompt responses, even previously accepted ones.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-3.condition: Retry after DX or D7 decline
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-3.constraint: Include all available prompt responses in retry

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-4.statement: If decline code D7, one or more prompts did not match expected values; invalid prompts indicated by '?'.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-4.constraint: Invalid prompts marked with '?' in prompt formatting section

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-5.statement: Values entered for all prompts must be sent with the capture message when pumping is complete.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-5.constraint: Include all prompt values in capture message

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-6.statement: In online processing, product categories not included in authorization response are considered not allowed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-6.constraint: Product category absent from response = not allowed

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-7.statement: In offline processing mode, device determines allowed products based on settings in the Dynamic Card Table.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-7.constraint: Use Dynamic Card Table settings to determine allowed products

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-8.statement: If approved maximum dollar amount is more than the AFP pump limit, the pump limit may take precedence.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-138-9.statement: If approved maximum dollar amount is less than the AFP pump limit, the approved amount takes precedence.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-1.statement: POS device is responsible for enforcing quantity or amount limits on fuel and non-fuel products from authorization response.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-1.constraint: POS device must enforce fuel/non-fuel product limits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-2.statement: When partial approval occurs in ATL101 or higher formats, BUYPASS host sends Response Code value F (Partial Authorization code).
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-2.condition: Partial approval occurs in ATL101 or higher message format

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-3.statement: No special indicator exists in ATL100 or ISO 8583 formats when host returns approved maximum dollar amount different than requested amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-3.condition: ATL100 or ISO 8583 message format with partial approval

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-4.statement: Product Code Data must be sent in all WEX OTR Fleet transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-5.statement: In an authorization request, all fuel products available for dispensing should be sent with unit price, quantity of 1, and total amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-5.constraint: Send fuel products with unit price, quantity=1, total amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-6.statement: Authorization response returns limits for all fuel products and all non-fuel product categories allowed for the card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-6.constraint: Limits returned for fuel products and non-fuel categories

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-7.statement: In a capture request, actual amounts for each product should be sent in Product Code Data segment, with totals by category in non-fuel portion of WEX OTR data.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-7.constraint: Send actual product amounts and category totals

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-8.statement: If customer does not use Dynamic Card Table, mapping of product code to product category in Appendix M can be used.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-8.condition: Customer does not use Dynamic Card Table
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-8.constraint: Use Appendix M product code to category mapping

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-9.statement: Device should be prepared to send and receive additional WEX OTR data described in applicable message specification.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-139-9.constraint: Support additional WEX OTR data fields

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-1.statement: Merchant Profile at BUYPASS must have Terminal Special Code 179 enabled for Money Code processing.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-1.constraint: Terminal Special Code 179 must be enabled

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-3.statement: If application doesn't process Table Load, it must have another method to determine if Money Code transactions are allowed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-3.condition: application does not process Table Load from BUYPASS
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-3.constraint: must provide alternate method to allow Money Code transactions

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-4.statement: Only POS Authorization Only Transaction is supported for Money Code processing.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-140-4.constraint: transaction type limited to POS Authorization Only

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-141-3.statement: WEX OTR Fleet transactions must send actual product amounts in Product Code Data segment, totals in non-fuel product portion of WEX OTR data.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-141-3.constraint: Send actual amounts per product in Product Code Data; totals per category in non-fuel WEX OTR data

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-1.statement: For Fleet One cards, Driver ID is not prompted but Odometer and Vehicle ID are always prompted.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-1.constraint: Driver ID N/A; Odometer always prompt (max 8 digits); Vehicle ID always prompt (max 10 digits)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-10.statement: Fleetwide card account number format is 707685 plus an 11-digit PAN.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-11.statement: Fuelman card account number format is 707649 plus an 11-digit PAN.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-2.statement: For Fleetwide cards, Driver ID and Odometer are always prompted; Vehicle No. and ID No. are not applicable.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-2.constraint: Driver ID 1-5 digits; Odometer 1-6 digits; Vehicle No./ID No. N/A

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-3.statement: For Fuelman cards, Driver ID and Odometer are always prompted; Vehicle No. and ID No. are not applicable.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-3.constraint: Driver ID 1-5 digits; Odometer 1-6 digits; Vehicle No./ID No. N/A

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-4.statement: Fleet One Driver ID value, when prompted, is a maximum of 8 digits.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-5.statement: Fleet One Vehicle ID value is a maximum of 10 digits.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-6.statement: Fleetwide/Fuelman Driver ID value: minimum 1 digit, maximum 5 digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-6.condition: Fleet Card Type = Fleetwide or Fuelman

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-7.statement: Fleetwide/Fuelman Odometer value: minimum 1 digit, maximum 6 digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-7.condition: Fleet Card Type = Fleetwide or Fuelman

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-8.statement: All products are allowed for Fleet One, Fleetwide, and Fuelman card types.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-144-9.statement: Fleet One card account number format is 501486 plus a 13-digit PAN.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-1.statement: MasterCard Fleet swiped: Driver ID prompted if Product Type Code = 3, max 6 digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-1.constraint: Prompt for Driver ID, max 6 digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-13.statement: MasterCard Fleet full account number ranges: 553231-553380, 556083-556099, 556100-556599, 556700-556999+ 10-digit PAN.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-13.constraint: Account must fall in specified BIN ranges for MasterCard Fleet

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-2.statement: MasterCard Fleet swiped: Odometer Reading prompted if Product Type Code = 1, 2, 3, or 4, max 7 digits.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-3.statement: MasterCard Fleet swiped: Vehicle No. prompted if Product Type Code = 2, max 6 digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-3.constraint: Prompt for Vehicle No., max 6 digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-4.statement: MasterCard Fleet swiped: ID No. prompted if Product Type Code = 1, max 6 digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-4.constraint: Prompt for ID No., max 6 digits
flags: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: TRACEBACK_MISMATCH: table shows 'Prompt if Fuel only if Product Type Code = 1' for ID No. column, not 'Product Type Code = 1' alone; column header association ambiguous but text says ID No. prompt condition is 'Prompted' unconditionally, with 'Type Code = 1' tied to Restrictions, not ID No.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-5.statement: MasterCard Fleet: fuel only allowed if Product Restriction Code = 2; otherwise all products allowed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-5.constraint: Fuel only; otherwise all products allowed

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-6.statement: MasterCard Fleet keyed entry: Driver ID and Vehicle No. not prompted; Odometer and ID No. prompted; all products allowed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-145-6.constraint: Odometer and ID No. prompted; others not prompted

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-1.statement: For Voyager card, prompt for Driver ID if first digit of Product Restriction Code = 1 or 3, max 6 digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-1.condition: Voyager card, first digit of Product Restriction Code = 1 or 3
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-1.constraint: Prompt for Driver ID, maximum of 6 digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-2.statement: For Voyager card, prompt for Odometer Reading if first digit of Product Restriction Code = 2 or 3, max 8 digits.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-2.condition: Voyager card, first digit of Product Restriction Code = 2 or 3
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-2.constraint: Prompt for Odometer, maximum of 8 digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-3.statement: Voyager card: Vehicle Number is not prompted since there is no Vehicle No. for this card type.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-4.statement: Voyager card: fuel only allowed if 2nd digit of Product Restriction Code = 1; otherwise all products allowed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-4.constraint: Only fuel products allowed; otherwise all products allowed

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-5.statement: Voyager full account number format = 7088 prefix + 15-digit PAN.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-146-6.statement: ID No. field is N/A for Voyager cards (both swiped and keyed entry modes).

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-1.statement: WEX swiped cards: Driver ID, Odometer, Vehicle ID, ID No. prompts per WEX-specific POS Prompt Codes.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-1.condition: Fleet Card Type = WEX, Entry Mode = Swiped
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-1.constraint: Prompt per WEX-Specific POS Prompt Codes; Driver ID max 10 digits, Odometer max 9 digits, Vehicle No. max 8 digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-2.statement: WEX swiped offline mode: only fuel products allowed if Purchase Restriction = 00.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-2.condition: WEX card, Swiped, offline mode, Purchase Restriction = 00

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-3.statement: WEX swiped: all products allowed if Purchase Restriction is any value other than 00.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-4.statement: WEX keyed entry: if a Prompt Code appears on front of card, enter the Prompt Code for Driver ID; else prompt for Driver ID.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-4.constraint: Enter Prompt Code if present, else prompt Driver ID (max 10 digits)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-5.statement: WEX keyed entry: if a Prompt Code appears on front of card, enter it for Odometer; else prompt for Odometer Reading.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-5.constraint: Enter Prompt Code if present, else prompt Odometer Reading (max 9 digits)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-6.statement: WEX keyed entry: always prompt for Vehicle ID, value is 8 digits embossed on front of card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-6.constraint: Vehicle ID = 8 digits embossed on card

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-147-7.statement: WEX keyed entry: attendant must validate purchase restrictions on card against products being purchased.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-15-1.statement: AFP interface requests authorizations and draft capture for credit, debit, fleet, stored value, and oil company card purchases.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-16-1.statement: BUYPASS assigns one merchant number to the overall AFP system.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-16-1.constraint: One merchant number per AFP system

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-16-10.statement: Controller/device should allow configuration of preauthorization amounts.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-16-2.statement: BUYPASS assigns one device number to the overall AFP system.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-16-2.constraint: One device number per AFP system

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-16-8.statement: Controller/device should request, receive, and store download parameters from BUYPASS.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-17-6.statement: A transaction declined by BUYPASS cannot be resubmitted.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-1.statement: If terminal finds values not included in this table, it should prompt for Driver ID and Odometer.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-1.condition: WEX Track 2 Field 6/Field 10 value not in table
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-1.constraint: Prompt for Driver ID and Odometer

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-3.statement: POS and CAT terminals use fields 6 and 10 of WEX card Track 2 data to determine customer prompting.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-173-3.constraint: Determine prompts from Track 2 fields 6 and 10

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-174-2.statement: Vehicle ID is a new prompt value, distinct from the Vehicle Card Number in Track 2 or embossed on the card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-174-2.constraint: Vehicle ID prompt must not be confused with Vehicle Card Number

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-3.statement: If no response received for debit completion, device must resend on next connection or within 15 minutes, whichever occurs first.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-3.condition: No response received to debit card completion
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-3.constraint: Resend request within 15 minutes or at next connection attempt

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-6.statement: For Message Format Version ATL100 and higher, Approved Amount in an approved Authorization Only response can differ from requested amount for debit transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-6.condition: Message Format Version Identifier ATL100+, Response Code = 0, debit card transaction
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-6.constraint: Approved Amount may differ from requested amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-8.statement: For Message Format Version ATL101 and higher, Approved Amount in Partial Approval response (Response Code=F) differs from requested amount for debit transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-8.condition: Message Format Version Identifier ATL101+, Response Code = F, debit card transaction
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-8.constraint: Approved Amount differs from requested amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-9.statement: CAT Purchase/Completion transaction must be transmitted from device no later than 55 minutes after creation by controller.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-9.condition: Petroleum credit card CAT Purchase/Completion transaction
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-18-9.constraint: Must transmit within 55 minutes of creation

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-183-4.statement: For DF32-DF6F (Enter Voyager Data), send Voyager EMV Tag for these values.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-183-4.constraint: Send Voyager EMV Tag for these values

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-185-3.statement: Voyager reserves the right to define liability rules and allowance of selectable CVM configuration practice.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-185-3.constraint: Voyager defines liability rules for selectable kernel practice

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-185-4.statement: Merchants with selectable kernel should provide mechanism to turn off such functionality as required by Voyager.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-185-4.constraint: Must provide mechanism to disable functionality

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-187-1.statement: TAC Denial required setting is '00 00 00 00 00' for Voyager Fleet contact transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-187-2.statement: TAC Online required setting is 'FE 50 BC 98 00' for Voyager Fleet contact transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-187-3.statement: TAC Default required setting is 'FE 50 BC 80 00' for Voyager Fleet contact transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-1.statement: For ATL100+, Approved Amount in approved Authorization Only response can differ from requested amount for stored value cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-1.condition: Message Format Version Identifier ATL100 or higher, Response Code = 0, stored value card
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-1.constraint: Approved Amount may differ from requested amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-2.statement: For ATL101+, Approved Amount in Partial Approval response differs from requested amount for stored value cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-2.condition: Message Format Version Identifier ATL101 or higher, Response Code = F, stored value card
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-2.constraint: Approved Amount is different from requested amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-3.statement: Device must pump the Approved Amount, not the requested amount, for stored value card transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-3.condition: Stored value card transaction with differing approved amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-4.statement: On non-CAT transactions, remaining balance should be handled as a split tender transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-4.condition: Non-CAT transaction with remaining balance after stored value card approval
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-4.constraint: Treat remaining balance as split tender

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-6.statement: If DLL flag is set in host response message, controller connects to BUYPASS and requests encryption load once queue is empty.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-6.condition: DLL flag set in host response message
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-6.constraint: Controller requests encryption load once queue empty

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-7.statement: PIN entry is required for debit and some fleet cards before pumping fuel.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-19-7.condition: Card type = debit or certain fleet cards

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-2.statement: CAT Authorization Only Request format must indicate a customer-activated device initiated the transaction.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-2.constraint: Format must indicate customer-activated device origin

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-3.statement: Controller supplies anticipated fuel type and price per gallon, required for fuel limits and fuel-only card validation.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-3.constraint: Fuel type and price per gallon required

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-4.statement: If approval received, device signals AFP system to dispense fuel up to preapproved Preauthorization amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-20-4.constraint: Dispense fuel up to preauthorization amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-21-4.statement: A stored preauthorized completion transaction should never initiate a call to BUYPASS.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-21-4.constraint: Preauthorized completion never triggers a call

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-1.statement: POS Authorization Only transaction verifies fund availability and authorizes purchase for specific dollar amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-1.constraint: Authorizes purchase for specific dollar amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-3.statement: Prepay transaction uses a POS Capture transaction to complete once fueling is finished.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-4.statement: Valid payment methods for POS Authorization Only transaction are debit, credit, fleet, stored value, or proprietary card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-4.constraint: Payment method must be debit, credit, fleet, stored value, or proprietary card

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-5.statement: Valid payment methods for a Prepay transaction are credit, fleet or proprietary cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-5.constraint: Payment method must be credit, fleet, or proprietary card

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-6.statement: No receipt is required for a POS Authorization Only transaction.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-23-7.statement: POS Authorization Only transaction does not use address verification.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-1.statement: Inside purchase valid payment methods: debit, credit, fleet, stored value, EBT, or proprietary cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-1.constraint: Payment method must be debit, credit, fleet, stored value, EBT, or proprietary

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-2.statement: Prepay capture valid payment methods: credit, fleet or proprietary cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-2.constraint: Payment method must be credit, fleet or proprietary

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-3.statement: Capture of POS authorization only valid payment methods: credit, fleet, or proprietary cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-3.constraint: Payment method must be credit, fleet, or proprietary

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-4.statement: Forced/off-line purchase valid payment methods: credit, fleet, and proprietary cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-4.constraint: Payment method must be credit, fleet, and proprietary

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-5.statement: Capture of POS authorization only is dependent upon a prior Authorization Only transaction.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-6.statement: A receipt is printed for POS Authorization Only transaction for the specific dollar amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-6.constraint: Print receipt for specific dollar amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-7.statement: If actual purchase amount differs from Authorization Only receipt amount, a second receipt is printed for POS Capture transaction's actual amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-7.condition: Actual purchase amount differs from Authorization Only receipt amount
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-24-7.constraint: Print additional receipt for actual dollar amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-73-9.statement: If manual entry is used, an asterisk (*) is shown before Account Number on receipt and journal.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-73-9.constraint: Asterisk prefixed to Account Number on receipt/journal

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-2.statement: Account Number Check Digit verifies Account Number (field 4 Track 1; field 3 Track 2) via Mod 10 evaluation.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-2.constraint: Mod 10 Check Digit evaluation on Account Number Check Digit

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-3.statement: Manual entry processing: Account Number Check Digit verifies first eight digits of embossed data.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-3.constraint: Check Digit verifies first eight embossed digits

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-4.statement: Super Check Digit verifies full Account Number (fields 3-6 Track 1; fields 2-5 Track 2) via Mod 10.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-4.constraint: Mod 10 Check Digit evaluation on Super Check Digit

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-5.statement: Manual entry processing: Super Check Digit verifies all embossed data and ISO data.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-5.constraint: Super Check Digit verifies embossed and ISO data

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-6.statement: For Magstripe transactions, device must interpret Restriction Code field to determine if odometer reading required.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-6.constraint: Odometer reading required if Restriction Code indicates

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-7.statement: Odometer reading can have a length of 1-8 digits when required.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-8.statement: For Magstripe transactions, there is no Vehicle Number for the Voyager fleet card.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-9.statement: For Magstripe transactions, device must interpret Restriction Code to determine if transaction is fuel-and-other-products or fuel-only.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-74-9.constraint: Restriction Code determines fuel-only vs fuel-and-other

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-1.statement: The Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-10.statement: Default track sent to BUYPASS on an original transaction should be Track 2.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-11.statement: Card data in a follow-on transaction must be partial Track 2 Data.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-12.statement: TransArmor-VeriFone Edition processing does not follow the partial Track 2 rule; full Track 2 Data is sent.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-12.constraint: Full Track 2 Data sent instead of partial

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-13.statement: Partial Track 2 Data = PAN + '=' + 4-digit expiration date (YYMM), no discretionary data after.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-13.constraint: Format: PAN + '=' + YYMM expiration date only

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-2.statement: Voyager host may return an approved maximum dollar amount in Authorization Response, differing from requested amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-2.condition: Voyager fleet card Authorization Only Request transaction
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-2.constraint: Approved maximum dollar amount must be <= requested amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-3.statement: If approved maximum dollar amount exceeds AFP pump limit, the pump limit may take precedence.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-3.condition: CAT Authorization Only transaction and approved max > AFP pump limit

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-4.statement: If approved maximum dollar amount is less than AFP pump limit, the approved maximum dollar amount takes precedence.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-4.condition: CAT Authorization Only transaction and approved max < AFP pump limit
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-4.constraint: Approved maximum dollar amount takes precedence

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-5.statement: For Voyager fleet card POS Authorization Only transactions, approval/denial is based on the actual amount sent in the Authorization Request.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-5.condition: Voyager fleet card POS Authorization Only transaction
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-5.constraint: Approval/denial based on actual requested amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-6.statement: When approved amount differs from requested, ATL101 or higher sends Response Code F (Partial Authorization).
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-6.condition: Approved maximum dollar amount differs from requested amount (ATL101+)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-7.statement: No special indicator exists in ATL100 or ISO 8583 formats for the partial approval scenario.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-8.statement: Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-8.constraint: Product Code Data segment is required

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-9.statement: Sum of all products in the product segment must equal the total transaction amount.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-75-9.constraint: Sum of Product Amount values = total transaction amount

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-1.statement: Terminals must check Service Code at track2 position 31 or track1 position 58 for Voyager cards.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-1.constraint: Check position 31 (Track2) or 58 (Track1) for Service Code

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-2.statement: If Service Code begins with '2' or '6', terminal must request cardholder insert card into chip reader.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-2.constraint: Terminal must prompt cardholder to insert card

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-3.statement: New 'Truck Class' value included in Track1 position 63 and Track2 position 36.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-3.constraint: Truck Class located at Track1 pos 63 / Track2 pos 36

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-4.statement: Voyager Cards do not follow ISO7813 standards for Track data encoding.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-76-4.constraint: Service Code not positioned where terminals typically expect it

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-1.statement: only one application is mutually supported — this application is automatically selected.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-1.condition: only one application is mutually supported

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-2.statement: Voyager Fleet Card payment application must be priority 1 when multiple applications exist on chip card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-2.condition: Voyager chip card has more than one application
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-2.constraint: Voyager Fleet Card payment application must be priority 1

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-3.statement: When only one application is mutually supported, it is automatically selected.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-4.statement: When several applications are mutually supported, terminal must automatically select highest-priority application defined by card issuer.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-4.constraint: Terminal selects application with highest issuer-defined priority

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-5.statement: If Unique Identifier subfield most significant bit is 0b, Device Type subfield is present and Proprietary Data subfield max length is 26 bytes.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-5.constraint: Device Type subfield present; Proprietary Data max 26 bytes

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-6.statement: For Voyager Fleet cards, Device Type will always be included in Third Party Data.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-7.statement: Unique Identifier '8003 or '0003 indicates a MasterCard defined Product Extension is present in Proprietary Data subfield.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-7.constraint: MasterCard defined Product Extension present in Proprietary Data

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-77-8.statement: Country Code for Voyager cards will be coded as 08 40 per ISO 3166-1.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-1.statement: Driver and Vehicle card bits must be turned off.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-2.statement: If bit 8 of Product Type Code is set, terminal must use Fleet Prompt Script File for all Voyager fleet prompts.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-2.constraint: Use Fleet Prompt Script File; other bits ignored

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-3.statement: Vehicle or Driver Number field is optional if Fleet Prompt Script File is not used.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-3.condition: Fleet Prompt Script File not used
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-3.constraint: Proprietary Data Field limited to 5 bytes in length

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-4.statement: If Fleet Prompt Script File is used, Vehicle or Driver Number field must be present, even as filler (0x000000).
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-4.constraint: Field must be present, possibly as filler 0x000000

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-5.statement: Voyager Fleet Cards will always define Vehicle or Driver Number field as 0x000000.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-6.statement: Fleet Prompt Script File Entry field must be present if bit 8 of Product Type Code is set.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-6.constraint: Fleet Prompt Script File Entry field must be present

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-78-8.statement: Value 0x0001 is assigned to fleet cards for Product Identifier.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-1.statement: Data must be set to '0001' to indicate Enhanced Fleet Support.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-1.constraint: set to '0001' to indicate Enhanced Fleet Support

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-2.statement: Third Party Data (9F6E) must be present in FCI of Voyager Fleet ADF to support Enhanced Fleet Processing.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-2.condition: Terminal supports Voyager EMV Fleet cards
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-2.constraint: Third Party Data (Tag 9F6E) must be present

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-3.statement: A value of '0003' or '8003' in Unique Identifier of Third Party Data indicates Enhanced Fleet Prompting is supported.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-3.constraint: Enhanced Fleet Prompting is supported by the card product

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-4.statement: Unique Identifiers other than '0003' or '8003' are not to be considered a Voyager Fleet product.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-5.statement: Product Identifier within Proprietary Data component must be '0001' to indicate Enhanced Fleet Support.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-6.statement: Any Product Identifier value other than '0001' indicates a non-fleet product.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-7.statement: If Product Type Code does not indicate Prompt Script File support, terminal must prompt for Odometer, Driver Number, Vehicle Number, ID Number per bits 4-1.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-7.condition: Product Type Code does not indicate Prompt Script File support
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-7.constraint: Prompt for terminal-defined fields in order of highest bit (4,3,2,1)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-8.statement: If Product Type Code indicates Prompt Script File support, terminal must read the file and prompt as indicated.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-8.condition: Product Type Code indicates Prompt Script File support
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-79-8.constraint: Terminal reads Prompt Script File and prompts accordingly

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-1.statement: Device must interpret Restriction Code (Tag 9F6E Third Party Data) to determine fuel-only vs fuel-and-other-products.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-1.constraint: Interpret Tag 9F6E to determine product restriction

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-2.statement: If card removed before card removal request, transaction must be aborted and Driver informed.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-2.condition: Card removed before terminal's card removal request

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-3.statement: If terminal already received authorization response, it must send a reversal message to the Voyager Authorization Host.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-3.condition: Authorization response already received before abort
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-3.constraint: Send reversal message to Voyager Authorization Host

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-4.statement: Terminal may print a receipt after an aborted transaction due to card removal.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-5.statement: Terminal should store information related to declined transaction for troubleshooting.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-5.constraint: Store chip-related data and declined transaction info

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-6.statement: Recommended minimum stored data includes chip-related data elements and IAC parameters, truncated PAN, and PAN Sequence Number.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-6.constraint: Store IAC parameters, truncated PAN, PAN Sequence Number

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-7.statement: Terminal should support a maintenance function to print or display stored troubleshooting information.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-8.statement: Terminal should be able to print or display current TAC, Terminal Capabilities, and Additional Terminal Capabilities parameters.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-80-8.constraint: Display/print current TAC and capability parameters

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-81-1.statement: Between 1st and 2nd GENERATE AC, terminal completes transaction by requesting 'Unable to go online - ACC' then sends a void to Voyager.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-81-1.condition: Between 1st GENERATE AC and 2nd GENERATE AC command
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-81-1.constraint: Request Unable to go online - AAC and send void to Voyager

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-81-2.statement: If transaction approved after completion, it should be voided by the POS terminal.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-82-1.statement: Voyager AID value is A0000000049999C00016, composed of RIID A000000004 and PIX 9999C00016.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-82-2.statement: Voyager has no specific requirements for EMV terminal parameters common to all applications; values follow Payment Industry standard.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-83-1.statement: Terminal Type (9F35) must be online capable, either online-only or offline with online capability, for Voyager.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-83-1.constraint: Terminal Type must be online capable

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-1.statement: Partial match of AID is supported for Application Selection Indicator.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-1.constraint: Terminal AID may match card AID partially for support determination.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-2.statement: Default DDOL value is 9F3704 if DDOL not present in card.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-2.constraint: Use default value 9F3704 for INTERNAL AUTHENTICATE command.
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Default Dynamic Data Authentication Data Object List (DDOL)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-3.statement: Default TDOL is not required if TDOL not present in card.
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Default Transaction Certificate Data Object List (TDOL)

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-5.statement: TAC parameter values indicate Terminal Action Code per Voyager AID per Appendix L.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-5.constraint: See Appendix L for Voyager Terminal Action Codes.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-7.statement: All EMV terminal parameter values apply to all Voyager AIDs; no AID-specific values exist.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-84-7.constraint: No Voyager-defined EMV terminal parameters dedicated to each Voyager application.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-1.statement: CDA must be implemented according to EMV 4.

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-10.statement: Terminal must support at least two Voyager Certification Authority Public Keys for the Voyager RID.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-10.constraint: Support at least 2 Voyager CA Public Keys per RID

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-11.statement: EMV mandates support of at least 6 Certification Authority Public Keys per RID.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-11.constraint: At least 6 CA Public Keys per RID per EMV

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-12.statement: Terminal must support RSA key length of 248 bytes and RSA key exponent equal to 3 or (2^16 + 1).
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-12.constraint: RSA key length 248 bytes, exponent 3 or 2^16+1

BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-13.statement: Terminal must be capable to check the integrity of the Certification Authority Public Keys.
BR-BUYPASS-PIPS-85-13.constraint: Must verify CA Public Key integrity
