BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-80-4.statement: For Amex, if Online PIN is mutually selected, terminal sets TVR Byte 3 Bit 3 but does not request PIN until final amount known.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-80-4.constraint: Set TVR Byte 3 Bit 3, defer PIN prompt until final amount known

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-80-8.statement: Visa recommends setting CVM Limit Supported to $0 when amount is not known.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-80-8.constraint: Recommend CVM Limit Supported set to $0

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-83-6.statement: Effective OCT-18, Visa supports a 'Deferred Authorization' indicator on authorization requests, mandated by APR-19.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-83-6.constraint: Support Deferred Authorization indicator; mandatory by APR-19

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-83-8.statement: Tag 9A (Transaction Date) is used by issuers as a variable in the ARQC algorithm and must reflect actual cardholder transaction date.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-83-8.constraint: Tag 9A must be actual date of cardholder's EMV transaction

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-84-1.statement: EMV offline approved transactions should be uploaded to host periodically throughout the day, not all at settlement.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-84-1.constraint: Upload periodically rather than at settlement

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-1.statement: EMV refund must include DE 55 chip data with AAC in online refund request if chip returns AAC decline.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-1.condition: Chip returns AAC at 1st GENERATE AC for refund
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-1.constraint: POS must include DE 55 chip data with AAC, POS Entry Mode must reflect chip transaction

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-2.statement: EMV refund must include DE 55 chip data with ARQC and send 2nd GENERATE AC if chip returns ARQC.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-2.condition: Chip returns ARQC at 1st GENERATE AC for refund
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-2.constraint: POS must send 2nd GENERATE AC with Issuer response before card removal

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-3.statement: If debit refund request times out, attempt to reprocess original authorization request if possible.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-3.constraint: Reprocess original authorization or use alternate method; avoid double refund

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-4.statement: Online Debit Refunds are not required to be an EMV transaction; magnetic stripe swipe is allowed.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-4.constraint: Refund can use MSR track data instead of EMV

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-5.statement: Online PIN Debit Returns may not be applicable for all Global Debit AIDs.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-86-5.constraint: Some Global Debit AIDs do not support Online PIN Debit Returns

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-87-1.statement: Debit Online or Near Real Time Debit Merchandise Returns can be EMV transactions if desired.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-87-1.condition: Client has appropriate agreements and supports MSR Online Debit Refunds
flags: UNRESOLVED_ENTITY_REF:Debit (Online or Near Real Time Debit) Merchandise Returns

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-87-2.statement: Online PIN Debit Returns must be sent in the Single/Debit Message, not Dual/Credit message, even if CAID is supported.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-87-2.condition: Transaction is Online PIN Debit Return
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-87-2.constraint: Must use Single/Debit Message, not Dual/Credit message

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-87-6.statement: Fiserv does not support settling of 17-19-digit PANs as credit; 19-digit PANs must always be authorized and settled as debit.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-87-6.constraint: Must be authorized and settled as debit transaction

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-1.statement: S PINless is a feature for which a client must be properly entitled.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-4.statement: For POS PINless, CVM selected must be 'No CVM' and no PIN Block data is sent.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-4.constraint: CVM = No CVM; no PIN Block data sent

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-5.statement: POS PINless transaction amount can be any amount above or below $50.00, depending on platform and message indicators.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-5.constraint: Amount may be above or below $50.00

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-7.statement: Merchant must have POS PINless entitlement at merchant level for transactions below and/or above $50.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-7.constraint: Merchant must be entitled for POS PINless

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-88-9.statement: PINless transactions are not supported on the Omaha Front and Back End Platforms.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-2.statement: The Union Pay CAID will not be supported for either MSR or EMV POS PINless.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-2.constraint: Not supported for MSR or EMV POS PINless

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-3.statement: POS PINless is not supported for MCC 5542 (AFD).

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-6.statement: No CVM Visa CAID dual message transaction must print a signature line if amount exceeds No Signature program limits.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-6.condition: Transaction amount above No Signature program limit per MCC

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-7.statement: Visa CAID with online PIN must not be submitted in a Dual/Credit message if merchant has only credit entitlement.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-7.constraint: Do not submit Visa CAID with online PIN in Dual/Credit message

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-8.statement: Visa CAID with online PIN must not be submitted in Dual/Credit message if 'Final Amount Indicator' is used.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-8.condition: 'Final Amount Indicator' is used in the message
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-8.constraint: Do not submit Visa CAID with online PIN in Dual/Credit message

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-9.statement: 2201: Remove CAID and Global Debit AID from Candidate List if merchant not entitled for PIN/Debit/PINless/Signature Debit.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-9.condition: Merchant profile not entitled for PIN, Debit, PINless POS Debit or Signature Debit
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-89-9.constraint: Remove CAID and Global Debit AIDs from Candidate List

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-90-1.statement: POS PINless is not supported for MCC 5542 (AFD).

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-90-5.statement: When Mastercard uses the Product Extension for Fleet, a Product Identifier has the value '0001'.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-90-5.condition: Mastercard Product Extension for Fleet used

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-90-7.statement: Fleet Card Solution 3 (Full Chip) sets card controls via Tag 9F0A (mandatory), DF30 (optional), DF32 (optional), and additional tags.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-90-7.constraint: 9F0A mandatory; DF30, DF32, other tags optional

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-90-8.statement: Authorization verifies prompted data elements: vehicle/driver/generic ID, odometer, work/purchase order number, trailer number, employee number.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-94-1.statement: All EMV POS Solutions must implement support to download updated CAPK files.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-94-1.constraint: Mandatory support for CAPK file download

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-95-1.statement: EMV POS Solutions must not download CAPK File 'round robin' between the two Data Centers.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-95-1.constraint: Download from a single server/datacenter only

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-95-3.statement: EMV POS Solutions should check for CAPK updates regularly and download as soon as possible.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-96-4.statement: Client must determine CAPK installation process for each device before implementing EMV in production.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-96-4.constraint: Determine status request/update process per device, possibly with terminal vendor

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-1.statement: Merchant ID (MID) must be truncated if present on EMV receipt.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-2.statement: Terminal ID (TID) must be truncated if present on EMV receipt.

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-4.statement: Magnetic stripe swipe receipt mandates have not changed and are not documented in this manual.
BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-4.constraint: Refer to Payment Brand or merchant specs

BR-FISERV-EMV-GUIDE-98-5.statement: Mandates to print or not print receipts have not changed with EMV implementation.
